segments.ko_txt: 5.2.1.3 사람 조혈전구세포의 비-거대핵세포 계열로의 분화
segments.en_txt: 5.2.1.3 Differentiation of Human Hematopoietic Progenitor Cells into Non-megakaryocytic Lineages

segments.ko_txt: • 사람 제대혈(cord blood) CD34+ 세포를 아바트롬보팍 또는 사이토카인 혼합액(줄기세포인자, GM-CSF, IL-3, 에리트로포이에틴)이 함유된 배지에 처리하여 10~12일 배양 후 전형적인 외형을 갖춘 집락을 현미경으로 확인함.
segments.en_txt: • Human cord blood CD34+ cells were treated with avatrombopag or a cytokine mixture (stem cell factor, GM-CSF, IL-3, and erythropoietin) in the culture medium and incubated for 10–12 days. Subsequently, typical colonies were observed under a microscope.

segments.ko_txt: - In situ에서 확인된 집락 유형은 20개 이상의 과립구나 대식세포로 정의되는 CFU-GM, 3개 이상의 적혈구모세포(erythroblast) 군집이나 이와 동등한 수(200개 이상)의 적혈구모세포로 정의되는 BFU-E, 과립구/대식세포/거대핵세포가 포함된 적혈구 집락으로 정의되는 CFU-Mix임.
segments.en_txt: - The types of colonies identified in situ included: CFU-GM, defined as colonies consisting of ≥20 granulocytes or macrophages; BFU-E, defined as clusters of ≥3 erythroblasts or an equivalent colony (≥200); and CFU-Mix, defined as erythroid colonies containing granulocytes, macrophages, and megakaryocytes

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍은 사람 거대핵세포 집락 형성에 관한 아바트롬보팍 EC50의 100배에 달하는 3 μmol/L의 농도에서도, 사람 조혈전구세포의 분화에 영향을 미치지 않았으며, 이는 아바트롬보팍이 사람 조혈전구세포의 거대핵세포로의 분화만 특이적으로 촉진함을 암시함.
segments.en_txt: - At a concentration of 3 μmol/L, which corresponds to 100 times the EC50 of avatrombopag for human megakaryocyte colony formation, avatrombopag did not affect the differentiation of human hematopoietic progenitor cells into non-megakaryocytic lineages. This indicates that avatrombopag specifically promotes the differentiation of human hematopoietic progenitor cells into megakaryocytes.

segments.ko_txt: - 사이토카인 혼합액은 사람 조혈모세포 집락 형성을 촉진하였으며, CFU-GM, BFU-E, CFU-Mix의 수를 증가시킴.
segments.en_txt: - The cytokine mixture enhanced the formation of human hematopoietic cell colonies, increasing the numbers of CFU-GM, BFU-E, and CFU-Mix

segments.ko_txt: 5.2.1.4 거대핵세포의 성숙
segments.en_txt: 5.2.1.4 Maturation of Megakaryocytes

segments.ko_txt: • 일반적으로 성숙한 거대핵세포는 증식은 하지 않으나, 유사분열의 후반부를 거치지 않으며 DNA 함량은 계속해서 증가하고, 거대핵세포의 배수성이 증가하면서 거대핵세포의 체적이 증가하는데, 이는 혈소판 생성에 필수적임. 세포질이 비대해지고 풍부해지면서 거대핵세포 하나가 수천 개의 혈소판을 생성할 수 있음.
segments.en_txt: • Mature megakaryocytes typically do not proliferate but instead undergo endomitosis, a process in which cell division is not completed, resulting in increased DNA content. This leads to higher ploidy and larger cell volume, which are essential for platelet production. As the cytoplasm of a megakaryocyte enlarges and becomes more abundant, a single megakaryocyte can produce thousands of platelets.

segments.ko_txt: • 아바트롬보팍이 거대핵세포 성숙에 미치는 영향을 평가하기 위하여, G-CSF에 의해 이동하는 사람 PB CD34+ 세포를 아바트롬보팍(30-3000nmol/L) 또는 rhTPO(0.03-10nmol/L)와 함께 무혈청 배지에서 12일 동안 배양한 후 거대핵세포(CD41 및 CD45 모두 발현)의 수와 그 배수성 정도를 유세포분석기로 측정 한 결과,
segments.en_txt: • To evaluate the effect of avatrombopag on megakaryocyte maturation, human PB CD34+ cells mobilized by G-CSF were cultured with avatrombopag (30–3000 nmol/L) or rhTPO (0.03–10 nmol/L) in serum-free medium for 12 days. Following culture, the number and ploidy of megakaryocytes expressing both CD41 and CD45 were assessed using flow cytometry. The results are as follows:

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍과 rhTPO 모두 사람 PB CD34+ 세포가 CD41+CD45+ 세포로 분화되는 것을 농도 의존적으로 촉진함.
segments.en_txt: - Both avatrombopag and rhTPO enhanced the differentiation of human PB CD34+ cells into CD41+CD45+ cells in a concentration-dependent manner

segments.ko_txt: - 배수성 분석 결과, 세포를 아바트롬보팍(3μmol/L) 또는 rhTPO(3nmol/L)와 함께 배양했을 때, 각 배수성 수준에서 약물 간 유의한 차이는 없었음.
segments.en_txt: - Ploidy analysis showed no significant differences between avatrombopag (3 μmol/L) and rhTPO (3 nmol/L) at each ploidy level

segments.ko_txt: - 배수성 분석 결과, 세포를 아바트롬보팍(3μmol/L) 또는 rhTPO(3nmol/L)와 함께 배양했을 때, 각 배수성 수준에서 약물 간 유의한 차이는 없었음.
segments.en_txt: - Ploidy analysis showed no significant differences between avatrombopag (3 μmol/L) and rhTPO (3 nmol/L) at each ploidy level

segments.ko_txt: • 아바트롬보팍은 사람 조혈전구세포가 다배수체 거대핵세포로 분화하는 것을 촉진하며 또한 아바트롬보팍 농도가 증가함에 따라 생성된 거대핵세포와 혈소판의 수가 증가하는 것으로 밝혀짐.
segments.en_txt: • These findings demonstrate that avatrombopag promotes the differentiation of human hematopoietic progenitor cells into polyploid megakaryocytes, and that increasing concentrations of avatrombopag result in increased numbers of megakaryocytes and platelet production

segments.ko_txt: - 또한 아바트롬보팍의 자극에 의해 생성된 거대핵세포의 배수성 수준은 rhTPO 자극에 의해 생성된 수준과 다르지 않음.
segments.en_txt: - In addition, the ploidy distribution of megakaryocytes induced by avatrombopag was comparable to that induced by rhTPO
5.2.1.7 Species Specificity

segments.ko_txt: • 사람, 랫드, 기니픽, 토끼, 비글견, 원숭이, 햄스터, 돼지, 침팬지의 전혈을 원심분리하여 혈소판 풍부 혈장을 얻고, 여기에 아바트롬보팍 또는 rhTPO를 처리하여 배양한 후 phospho-STAT5(Tyr694)를 이용하여 STAT5 티로신의 인산화를 유도할 수 있는지 평가한 결과,
segments.en_txt: • Whole blood from humans, rats, guinea pigs, rabbits, beagle dogs, monkeys, hamsters, pigs, and chimpanzees were centrifuged to obtain platelet-rich plasma, which was then incubated with avatrombopag or rhTPO. The ability to induce tyrosine phosphorylation of STAT5 was evaluated using anti-phospho-STAT5 (Tyr694) antibodies. The results are as follows:

segments.ko_txt: - rhTPO는 랫드, 기니픽, 토끼, 비글견, 마모셋, 원숭이의 혈소판에서 STAT5 티로신의 인산화를 유도하였으나, 아바트롬보팍은 이들 종의 혈소판에서 STAT5 티로신의 인산화를 유도하지 않음.
segments.en_txt: - rhTPO induced tyrosine phosphorylation of STAT5 in platelets from rats, guinea pigs, rabbits, beagle dogs, marmosets, and monkeys; however, avatrombopag did not induce tyrosine phosphorylation of STAT5 in the platelets of these species

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍(0.03μmol/L 및 그 이상)은 모든 침팬지 혈액 혈소판 검체(n=4; 수컷 1마리, 암컷 3마리)에서 5ng/mL rhTPO처럼 STAT5 티로신의 인산화를 유도함.
segments.en_txt: - Avatrombopag (≥0.03 μmol/L) induced tyrosine phosphorylation of STAT5 in all chimpanzee blood platelet samples tested (n=4; 1 male, 3 females), comparable to 5 ng/mL rhTPO

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍의 활성은 매우 종특이적이어서 사람과 침팬지의 c-Mpl만 활성화시킬 수 있음을 암시함.
segments.en_txt: - These results suggest that avatrombopag exhibits marked species specificity, activating c-Mpl only in humans and chimpanzees
5.2.1.8 Binding Site

segments.ko_txt: • TPO가 사람 c-Mpl에 결합하는 것을 억제하는 것으로 알려진 TM41은 125I-rhTPO가 사람 혈소판에 결합하는 것을 농도 의존적으로 억제하였으며(IC50은 515±32μmol/L), 반면에 아바트롬보팍은 최대 100μmol/L 농도까지 125I-rhTPO의 결합을 억제하지 않음.
segments.en_txt: • TM41, which is known to inhibit the binding of TPO to human c-Mpl, concentration-dependently inhibited the binding of 125I-rhTPO to human platelets (IC50: 515 ± 32 μmol/L). In contrast, avatrombopag did not inhibit the binding of 125I-rhTPO even at concentrations up to 100 μmol/L.

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍의 사람 c-Mpl 결합 부위가 rhTPO의 결합 부위와는 다름을 의미함.
segments.en_txt: - This indicates that the binding site of Avatrombopag on human c-Mpl is different from that of rhTPO

segments.ko_txt: 5.2.2. 생체 내 시험
segments.en_txt: 5.2.2. In Vivo Studies

segments.ko_txt: 5.2.2.1 혈소판 생성
segments.en_txt: 5.2.2.1 Platelet Production

segments.ko_txt: • 사람 태아 간 CD34+ 세포를 NOD/SCID 마우스에 이종 이식하면 사람의 거대핵세포 생성 및 혈소판 생성 연구를 위한 in vivo 모델을 얻을 수 있으며, 이 모델에 아바트롬보팍 0, 0.3, 1, 3mg/kg를 14일간 경구투여한 결과, 사람의 혈소판 수가 용량 의존적으로 증가함.
segments.en_txt: • Xenografting of human fetal liver CD34+ cells into NOD/SCID mice provides an in vivo model for studying human megakaryocytopoiesis and platelet production. In this model, oral administration of avatrombopag at doses of 0, 0.3, 1, and 3 mg/kg for 14 days resulted in a dose-dependent increase in human platelet count.

segments.ko_txt: - 1mg/kg 14일 경구투여는 약 2.7배 증가하며 3mg/kg 투여시에는 3배 증가함.
segments.en_txt: - Oral administration of avatrombopag at 1 mg/kg for 14 days resulted in an approximately 2.7-fold increase in human platelet count, while administration at 3 mg/kg led to a 3-fold increase

segments.ko_txt: - 최소 유효 용량 1mg/kg의 14일 반복투여한 후 혈장 내 미결합 아바트롬보팍의 농도는 약 5nmol/L(Cmax: 29.5ng/mL; 혈장단백결합률: 89.0~89.7%)로 추정됨.
segments.en_txt: - Following 14 days of repeated administration of the minimum effective dose of 1 mg/kg, the concentration of unbound avatrombopag in plasma is estimated to be approximately 5 nmol/L (Cmax: 29.5 ng/mL; plasma protein binding: 89.0 to89.7%).

segments.ko_txt: 5.2.3. 2차 약력학시험
segments.en_txt: 5.2.3. Secondary Pharmacodynamics

segments.ko_txt: 5.2.3.1 아바트롬보팍의 결합 패널 시험
segments.en_txt: 5.2.3.1 Avatrombopag Binding Panel Study

segments.ko_txt: • 86개의 수용체, 수송체, 이온채널에 대해 1 및 10μmol/L 농도에서 아바트롬보팍의 결합을 평가하였으며, 1 및 10μmol/L 농도에서 세크레틴 작용제 효과, 최대 10μmol/L까지의 5개 농도에서 CCK2 작용제/길항제 효과, 1 및 10μmol/L 농도에서 Na+/K+-ATPase, 그리고 최대 100μmol/L까지의 8개 농도에서 H+/K+-ATPase에 관한 효소 시험도 수행함.
segments.en_txt: • A binding panel study of avatrombopag was conducted to evaluate its binding affinity to 86 receptors, transporters, and ion channels at concentrations of 1 and 10 μmol/L; secretin agonist effects were assessed at concentrations of 1 and 10 μmol/L; CCK2 receptor agonist and antagonist effects were evaluated at five different concentrations up to 10 μmol/L; a Na+/K+-ATPase enzyme assay was performed at 1 and 10 μmol/L; and an H+/K+-ATPase enzyme assay was conducted at eight different concentrations up to 100 μmol/L.

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍 1μmol/L에서 유의한 효과(50% 초과 억제 또는 활성화)는 없었으며, 10μmol/L에서 아데노신 A3(A3), 안지오텐신 II type 1(AT1), CCK2, 무스카린성4(M4), 뉴로키닌2 (NK2), 뉴로키닌3(NK3), 5-hydroxytryptamine(세로토닌)5A(5-HT5a) 수용체, 그리고 N-type Ca2+ 채널에서 유의한 결합(50% 이상 억제)이 관찰됨.
segments.en_txt: - Avatrombopag at 1 μmol/L did not exhibit any significant effects (inhibition or activation >50%). At 10 μmol/L, significant binding (≥50% inhibition) was observed at the following receptors and ion channels: adenosine A3 (A3) receptor, angiotensin II type 1 (AT1) receptor, CCK2 receptor, muscarinic 4 (M4) receptor, neurokinin-2 (NK2) receptor, neurokinin-3 (NK3) receptor, 5-hydroxytryptamine (serotonin) 5A (5-HT5a) receptor, and the N-type Ca2+ channel.

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍은 CCK2 수용체에 대해서 IC50는 7.0μmol/L으로 길항 효과를 나타냄.
segments.en_txt: - Avatrombopag exhibited an antagonist effect on the CCK2 receptor, with an IC50 of 7.0 μmol/L.

segments.ko_txt: - 최대 10μmol/L 농도까지 Na+/K+-ATPase나 세크레틴 작용제 효과를 억제하지 않았으며, 또한 최대 100μmol/L 농도까지는 H+/K+-ATPase를 억제하지 않음.
segments.en_txt: - Avatrombopag did not inhibit Na+/K+-ATPase activity or secretin agonist effects up to a concentration of 10 μmol/L, nor did it inhibit H+/K+-ATPase activity up to a concentration of 100 μmol/L.

segments.ko_txt: 5.2.3.2 혈소판 응집
segments.en_txt: 5.2.3.2 Platelet Aggregation

segments.ko_txt: • 건강한 자원자로부터 얻은 혈소판풍부혈장(platelet rich plasma)에 아바트롬보팍(0.01, 0.1, 1, 10μmol/L), rhTPO (0.05, 0.5, 5, 50nmol/L), 또는 용매(0.35% BSA가 함유된 PBS)를 PRP에 가하고 상온에서 배양한 후 혈소판 응집을 측정한 결과,
segments.en_txt: • Platelet rich plasma (PRP) obtained from healthy volunteers was treated with avatrombopag (0.01, 0.1, 1, and 10 μmol/L), rhTPO (0.05, 0.5, 5, and 50 nmol/L), or vehicle control (PBS containing 0.35% BSA) and incubated at room temperature. Platelet aggregation was then measured, and the results are as follows:

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍은 ADP(혈소판응집 유도제)의 존재와 무관하게 혈소판 응집을 유도하거나 증가시키지 않은 반면 rhTPO(50nmol/L)는 ADP가 없을 때 혈소판 응집을 유의하게 유도하였으며, 또한 rhTPO(5 및 50nmol/L)는 ADP가 유도하는 혈소판 응집을 더욱 촉진시킴.
segments.en_txt: - Avatrombopag did not induce or enhance platelet aggregation, regardless of the presence of ADP (a platelet aggregation inducer). In contrast, rhTPO (50 nmol/L) significantly induced platelet aggregation even in the absence of ADP, and rhTPO (5 and 50 nmol/L) further enhanced ADP-induced platelet aggregation.

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍은 rhTPO가 혈소판을 응집시키는 최소 유효 농도(5nmol/L)보다 2000배나 높은 10μmol/L 농도에서도 혈소판 응집을 촉진하거나 유도하지 않음.
segments.en_txt: - Avatrombopag, even at a concentration of 10 μmol/L — approximately 2,000-fold higher than the minimal effective concentration of rhTPO (5 nmol/L) for platelet aggregation — did not induce or enhance platelet aggregation

segments.ko_txt: 5.2.3.3 혈소판 활성화
segments.en_txt: 5.2.3.3 Platelet Activation

segments.ko_txt: • CD62P는 혈소판 활성화 마커로서 혈소판이 활성화되면 혈장쪽 세포막으로 빠르게 이동함.
segments.en_txt: • CD62P is a marker of platelet activation. Upon platelet activation, CD62P is rapidly translocated to the plasma-facing side of the platelet membrane.

segments.ko_txt: • PRP에 아바트롬보팍(0.01, 0.1, 1, 10μmol/L), rhTPO(0.05, 0.5, 5, 50nmol/L), 또는 용매(0.35% BSA가 함유된 PBS)를 처리하고 10분 후 ADP나 식염수를 처리하여 상온에서 10분간 배양시킨 후, ADP로 자극된 혈소판에서 발현되는 CD62P를 검출하여 혈소판 활성화를 측정함.
segments.en_txt: • In this study, PRP was treated with avatrombopag (0.01, 0.1, 1, and 10 μmol/L), rhTPO (0.05, 0.5, 5, and 50 nmol/L), or vehicle (PBS containing 0.35% BSA). After 10 minutes, either ADP or saline was added, and the mixture was incubated at room temperature for an additional 10 minutes. The expression of CD62P on platelets activated by ADP was then measured to assess platelet activation.

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍은 ADP의 존재와 관계없이 사람 혈소판에서 CD62P의 발현을 유의하게 증가시키지 않았는데, 이는 아바트롬보팍이 혈소판 활성화에 영향을 미치지 않음을 암시함.
segments.en_txt: - Avatrombopag did not significantly increase CD62P expression in human platelets, regardless of the presence of ADP, suggesting that avatrombopag does not affect platelet activation

segments.ko_txt: - rhTPO는 ADP의 존재와 관계없이 사람 혈소판에서 CD62P의 발현을 유의하게 증가시킴. ADP가 존재할 때 rhTPO의 농도가 5nmol/L 이상이면 이러한 효과가 유의하였으며(P<0.001), ADP 농도가 높을 때에는 rhTPO의 농도가 0.5 nmol/L에서도 유의함(P<0.01). ADP가 없는 경우, rhTPO가 50nmol/L이면 CD62P의 발현을 유의하게 유도함.
segments.en_txt: - In contrast, rhTPO significantly increased CD62P expression in human platelets both in the presence and absence of ADP. In the presence of ADP, rhTPO at concentrations of ≥5 nmol/L significantly increased CD62P expression (p < 0.001), and at higher ADP concentrations, even 0.5 nmol/L rhTPO had a significant effect (p < 0.01). In the absence of ADP, rhTPO at 50 nmol/L significantly induced CD62P

segments.ko_txt: • 사람 태아 간 CD34+ 세포를 이식한 NOD/SCID 마우스에 아바트롬보팍(0 또는 3mg/kg)을 14일간 경구 투여한 후 15일차에 말초혈액을 수집하여, 트롬빈수용체작용제펩티드(thrombin receptor agonist peptide, TRAP)을 처리하여 혈소판을 활성화시킴.
segments.en_txt: • In an in vivo study using NOD/SCID mice transplanted with human fetal liver CD34+ cells, avatrombopag (0 or 3 mg/kg) was administered orally for 14 days. On day 15, peripheral blood was collected, and platelets were stimulated with thrombin receptor agonist peptide (TRAP).

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍을 경구 투여하면 사람 혈소판수가 증가하여, 투여 개시 후 15일차에는 혈소판수가 약 2배 증가함(p<0.05).
segments.en_txt: - Oral administration of avatrombopag resulted in an approximately two-fold increase in human platelet counts by day 15 post-administration (p < 0.05)

segments.ko_txt: - 반면에 사람 혈소판에서 TRAP으로 유도한 CD62P 발현은 아바트롬보팍 투여에도 바뀌지 않아, 용매군과 결과가 유사하게 나타남.
segments.en_txt: - However, TRAP-induced CD62P expression on human platelets did not differ between the avatrombopag-treated and vehicle control groups

segments.ko_txt: - 이 결과들은 아바트롬보팍이 NOD/SCID 마우스에서의 사람 혈소판 증식을 촉진하지만 아바트롬보팍을 2주간 노출하여도 사람 혈소판 분획에는 영향이 없음을 나타냄.
segments.en_txt: - These results indicate that although avatrombopag promotes the proliferation of human platelets in NOD/SCID mice, two weeks of exposure to avatrombopag does not affect platelet activation status

segments.ko_txt: 5.3.1 중추신경계에 대한 영향
segments.en_txt: 5.3.1 Impact on the Central Nervous System

segments.ko_txt: • 의식 있는 수컷 랫드에 아바트롬보팍 1, 10, 100mg/kg 단회 경구투여 후 CNS에 미치는 영향을 평가하기 위한 어윈시험을 수행하였으며, 최대 100mg/kg까지 CNS 파라미터에 영향을 미치지 않음.
segments.en_txt: • In an Irwin study to evaluate the effects on the CNS, conscious male rats were administered a single oral dose of Avatrombopag at 1, 10, and 100 mg/kg. It was observed that doses up to 100 mg/kg had no impact on CNS parameters.

segments.ko_txt: 5.3.2 호흡기계에 대한 영향
segments.en_txt: 5.3.2 Impact on the Respiratory System

segments.ko_txt: • 원격측정장치를 부착한 마취하지 않은 비글견에 아바트롬보팍(0, 3, 30, 300mg/kg)을 단회 경구 투여하여, 호흡기계(호흡률 및 혈액가스)에 미치는 영향을 평가한 결과, 아바트롬보팍 최대 300mg/kg까지 호흡기계에 영향을 미치지 않음.
segments.en_txt: • In a study conducted in non-anesthetized beagle dogs equipped with telemetry devices, a single oral dose of avatrombopag (0, 3, 30, and 300 mg/kg) was administered to assess its effects on the respiratory system (respiratory rate and blood gas parameters). The results demonstrated that avatrombopag did not affect the respiratory system at doses up to 300 mg/kg.

segments.ko_txt: - 30mg/kg 이상의 용량에서 tmax 즈음 구토가 발생함.
segments.en_txt: - Vomiting was observed at doses of ≥30, occurring around the time of maximum plasma concentration (Tmax)

segments.ko_txt: 5.3.3 심혈관계에 대한 영향
segments.en_txt: 5.3.3 Impact on the Cardiovascular System

segments.ko_txt: • hERG HEK293 세포를 이용하여 아바트롬보팍 0.1, 1, 3μmol/L이 hERG 전류에 미치는 영향을 평가한 결과, IC50 1.4μmol/L로 hERG 전류를 억제함.
segments.en_txt: • The effect of avatrombopag at concentrations of 0.1, 1, and 3 μmol/L on hERG currents was evaluated using hERG-transfected HEK293 cells, demonstrating inhibition with an IC50 of 1.4 μmol/L.

segments.ko_txt: • 기니픽에서 분리한 유두근을 이용하여 아바트롬보팍 0.1, 1, 3μmol/L이 안정 시 막전위(resting membrane potential), 활동전위 크기, 최대 dV/dt, 활동전위 지속시간(30%, 60%, 90% 재분극 시 활동전위 지속시간; 각각 APD30, APD60, APD90)에 미치는 영향을 평가한 결과, 아바트롬보팍은 시험한 최고 농도(1.37μmol/L)까지도 활동전위 파라미터에 영향을 미치지 않음.
segments.en_txt: • The effects of avatrombopag at concentrations of 0.1, 1, and 3 μmol/L on resting membrane potential, action potential amplitude, maximum dV/dt, and action potential duration (APD30, APD60, APD90, representing durations at 30%, 60%, and 90% repolarization, respectively) were assessed using isolated guinea pig papillary muscle The results showed that avatrombopag did not affect any action potential parameters up to the highest tested concentration of 1.37 μmol/L.

segments.ko_txt: • 원격측정장치를 부착한 마취하지 않은 비글견에 아바트롬보팍(0, 3, 30, 300mg/kg)을 단회 경구 투여하여, 심혈관계(혈압, 맥박수, 심전도) 및 임상적 징후, 체중, 사료 섭취, 체온, 독성동태학을 평가함.
segments.en_txt: • Telemetry devices were attached to non-anesthetized beagle dogs to evaluate cardiovascular parameters (blood pressure, heart rate, and electrocardiogram), as well as clinical signs, body weight, food consumption, body temperature, and toxicokinetics following single oral administration of avatrombopag at doses of 0, 3, 30, and 300 mg/kg

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍 최대 300mg/kg까지 심혈관계에 영향을 미치지 않음.
segments.en_txt: - Avatrombopag did not affect cardiovascular parameters at doses up to 300 mg/kg

segments.ko_txt: - 30mg/kg 이상의 용량에서 tmax 즈음 구토가 발생함.
segments.en_txt: -     Vomiting was observed at doses of ≥30, occurring around the time of maximum plasma concentration (Tmax)

segments.ko_txt: 5.3.4 신장/비뇨기계에 미치는 영향
segments.en_txt: 5.3.4 Impact on the Renal/urinary System

segments.ko_txt: • 수컷 비글견에 아바트롬보팍 3, 30, 300mg/kg 단회투여 후 임상징후, 체중, 사료섭취, 신장기능(사구체여과율, 유효신장혈장유량, 크레아티닌 청소율), 혈액화학, 독성동태학, 요검사, 신장조직검사를 평가함.
segments.en_txt: • Following single oral administration of avatrombopag at doses of 3, 30, and 300 mg/kg in male beagle dogs, clinical signs, body weight, food consumption, renal function (glomerular filtration rate, effective renal plasma flow, and creatinine clearance), blood chemistry, toxicokinetics, urinalysis, and renal histopathology were evaluated

segments.ko_txt: - 300mg/kg에서 대변색깔 및 양의 변화, BUN 및 크레아티닌 증가, 혈청 내 무기인 감소, 소변 내 단백질, 포도당, 케톤체, 잠혈의 발생, 요량 증가, 요삼투압 감소, 사구체여과율 감소, 유효신장혈장유량 감소 등이 관찰됨.
segments.en_txt: - At a dose of 300 mg/kg, the following changes were observed: alterations in stool color and quantity; increases in BUN and creatinine; a decrease in serum inorganic phosphorus; presence of protein, glucose, ketones, and blood in the urine; increased urine volume; decreased urine osmolality; reduced glomerular filtration rate; and decreased effective renal plasma flow

segments.ko_txt: - 이들 파라미터는 투여 7일 후에 회복되었으며, 신세뇨관에서 원주(cast)와 피질 단핵세포 침윤이 동반된 재생 및 세뇨관 확장 등 가역적인 조직 병변도 관찰됨.
segments.en_txt: - These changes were reversible and had returned to baseline within 7 days after administration. Histopathological examination revealed reversible lesions, including regeneration and tubular dilation in the renal tubules, accompanied by casts and mononuclear cell infiltration in the renal cortex.
5.4.1. Absorption (CTD 4.2.2.2)

segments.ko_txt: • 수컷 피셔 랫드와 수컷 필리핀원숭이에 아바트롬보팍(0.3~3mg/kg)을 단회 경구투여한 후 노출은 용량에 비례하여 증가하였으며 시험한 모든 종에서, 아바트롬보팍을 경구 투여한 후 2~5시간에 Cmax에 이르렀으며 t1/2은 3.9~7.2시간.
segments.en_txt: • In male Fischer rats and male cynomolgus monkeys, a single oral administration of avatrombopag (0.3–3 mg/kg) resulted in dose-proportional increases in systemic exposure. In all species tested, Cmax was reached within 2 to 5 hours after oral administration, and t1/2 ranged from 3.9 to 7.2 hours.

segments.ko_txt: • 절대적 생체이용률(F)는 마우스(1mg/kg)에서 91%, 피셔 랫드(0.3~3mg/kg)에서 89~94%, 개(1mg/kg)에서 52%, 필리핀원숭이(0.3~3mg/kg)에서 49~67%로 추정됨.
segments.en_txt: • The absolute bioavailability (F) of avatrombopag was estimated to be 91% in mice (1 mg/kg), 89–94% in Fischer rats (0.3–3 mg/kg), 52% in dogs (1 mg/kg), and 49–67% in cynomolgus monkeys (0.3–3 mg/kg)

segments.ko_txt: • SD 랫드에서 경구 투여한 용액 및 현탁액 제형의 F는 각각 51% 및 37%.
segments.en_txt: • In SD rats, the bioavailability of avatrombopag was 51% when administered as an oral solution and 37% when administered as a suspension formulation

segments.ko_txt: • SD 랫드에서 경구 투여한 용액 및 현탁액 제형의 F는 각각 51% 및 37%.
segments.en_txt: • In SD rats, the bioavailability of avatrombopag was 51% when administered as an oral solution and 37% when administered as a suspension formulation

segments.ko_txt: • 동물에서 식이영향 평가는 수행되지 않았으나, 임상에서 평가함.
segments.en_txt: • The effect of food on avatrombopag absorption was not evaluated in animal studies but was assessed in clinical studies

segments.ko_txt: • 수컷 피셔 랫드에서 in situ GI tract ligated loop method로 [14C]아바트롬보팍의 흡수를 측정한 결과, 가장 많이 흡수된 부위는 십이지장(투여량의 49.3%)이었으며, 이어 공장, 결장, 회장 순으로 나타나, 아바트롬보팍의 흡수는 대부분 소장 상부부터 중간부에서 일어나는 것으로 나타남.
segments.en_txt: • In male Fischer rats, absorption of [14C]-labeled avatrombopag was evaluated using the in situ gastrointestinal tract ligated loop method. The highest absorption was observed in the duodenum (49.3% of the dose), followed by the jejunum, colon, and ileum, indicating that avatrombopag is primarily absorbed in the upper to mid-small intestine.

segments.ko_txt: • [14C]아바트롬보팍 1mg/kg을 수컷 피셔(알비노) 랫드에 경구투여한 후, 혈액 및 혈장의 방사능 농도는 투여 후 3시간에 최대였으며 이후 감소하여 t1/2은 각각 5.5시간 및 5.7시간, 혈장 방사능의 대부분은 미변화 아바트롬보팍이었음.
segments.en_txt: • Following oral administration of [14C]-avatrombopag (1 mg/kg) to male Fischer (albino) rats, radioactivity in blood and plasma peaked at 3 hours post-dose and then declined, with t1/2 values of 5.5 hours in blood and 5.7 hours in plasma. The majority of radioactivity detected in plasma was attributable to unchanged avatrombopag.

segments.ko_txt: • 사람 골수 세포를 이식한 NOD/SCID 마우스에 아바트롬보팍을 약리학적 유효 용량인 1mg/kg로 14일간 경구투여하여 아바트롬보팍 PK를 평가한 결과 14일차에 최종 투여 후 Cmax는 29.5 ng/mL, AUC(0-24)는 430.5ng·h/mL으로 나타남.
segments.en_txt: • In NOD/SCID mice transplanted with human bone marrow cells, avatrombopag was administered orally at a pharmacologically effective dose of 1 mg/kg once daily for 14 days to evaluate its pharmacokinetic profile. On Day 14, following the final dose, the Cmax was 29.5 ng/mL, and the AUC(0–24) was 430.5 ng·h/mL.
5.4.2 Distribution (CTD 4.2.2.3)

segments.ko_txt: • 수컷 피셔(알비노) 랫드에 [14C]아바트롬보팍(1mg/kg)을 단회 경구투여한 후 조직의 방사능 농도는 고환을 제외한 모든 조직에서 투여 후 1~4시간에 최대였으며, 투여 1시간 후 방사능이 가장 높은 조직(위장관 제외)은 간(혈장의 약 11배)이었으며, 이어 부신, 신장, 심장, 악하선, 폐, 비장, 췌장, 골수 순으로 나타남.
segments.en_txt: • In male Fischer (albino) rats, following a single oral administration of [14C]-avatrombopag (1 mg/kg), radioactivity concentrations in tissues peaked within 1–4 hours post-dose in all tissues except the testes. At 1hour post-dose, the highest radioactivity concentration (excluding the gastrointestinal tract) was observed in the liver (approximately 11-fold higher than plasma), followed by the adrenal glands, kidneys, heart, submandibular glands, lungs, spleen, pancreas, and bone marrow.

segments.ko_txt: - 색소있는 수컷 롱에반스 랫드에서도 안구 방사능(방사능 반감기 351시간)을 제외하면 유사한 결과가 나타났으며, 전신의 자가조직방사선촬영술(autoradioluminography)에서도 동일한 조직 분포 결과가 확인됨.
segments.en_txt: - In pigmented male Long-Evans rats, similar distribution patterns were observed, except for ocular tissue, where the radioactivity exhibited a prolonged half-life of 351 hours. Systemic autoradioluminography confirmed the same tissue distribution pattern.

segments.ko_txt: • 아바트롬보팍의 in vitro 혈장단백결합률은 B6C3F1 마우스에서 87.2~89.1%, 피셔 랫드에서 87.6~89.2%, 뉴질랜드 흰토끼에서 88.3~92.0%, 비글견에서 97.3~97.9%, 필리핀원숭이에서 97.0~97.6%, 사람에서 96.3~96.6%였으며, 시험한 모든 종에서 농도의존적이지 않음.
segments.en_txt: • TThe in vitro plasma protein binding rates of avatrombopag were as follows: B6C3F1 mice: 87.2–89.1%; Fischer rats: 87.6–89.2%; New Zealand White rabbits: 88.3–92.0%; beagle dogs: 97.3–97.9%; cynomolgus monkeys: 97.0–97.6%; humans: 96.3–96.6%. Plasma protein binding was not concentration-dependent in any species tested.

segments.ko_txt: • 사람 혈청 알부민, 알파1-산 당단백질(α1-acid glycoprotein, AAG), 감마글로불린(γ-Globulin, GG)에 대한 아바트롬보팍의 in vitro 단백결합률은 모두 98.9% 또는 그 이상으로 나타남.
segments.en_txt: • The in vitro binding rate of avatrombopag to human serum albumin, α1-acid glycoprotein (AAG), and γ-globulin (GG) was ≥98.9%.

segments.ko_txt: • CD-1 마우스, SD 랫드, 뉴질랜드 흰토끼, 비글견, 필리핀원숭이, 사람에서 [14C]아바트롬보팍의 in vitro 혈액 대 혈장 농도비(RB)는 0.51~0.83이었으며 농도의존성은 없음.
segments.en_txt: • The in vitro blood-to-plasma concentration ratio (RB) of [14C]-avatrombopag in CD-1 mice, SD rats, New Zealand White rabbits, beagle dogs, cynomolgus monkeys, and humans ranged from 0.51 to 0.83, with no concentration dependency observed.

segments.ko_txt: • 임신한 SD 랫드에 [14C]아바트롬보팍 3mg/kg을 단회 경구투여하여 태반 통과를 평가한 결과, 임신 13일차 및 18일차 랫드에서 투여 후 최대 24시간에 모체 혈장 대비 태자의 방사능 비율은 각각 0.04~0.42 및 0.02~0.22으로 태자에 분포된 방사능은 투여량의 0.01% 이하로 나타남.
segments.en_txt: • In pregnant SD rats, placental transfer was evaluated following a single oral administration of [14C]-avatrombopag (3 mg/kg). In GD 13 and GD 18 rats, the fetal-to-maternal plasma radioactivity ratios at up to 24 hours post-dose were 0.04–0.42 and 0.02–0.22, respectively, and the radioactivity detected in the fetus was ≤0.01% of the administered dose.

segments.ko_txt: - 태자, 태자 혈장(임신 18일차 랫드에서만), 모체 혈장에 주로 존재하는 성분은 아바트롬보팍이었는데, 이는 아바트롬보팍이 태반을 통과하여 태자로 전달됨을 의미함.
segments.en_txt: - The main component detected in the fetus, fetal plasma (in GD18 rats), and maternal plasma was unchanged avatrombopag, indicating that avatrombopag crosses the placenta and is transferred to the fetus.
5.4.3 Metabolism (CTD 4.2.2.4)

segments.ko_txt: • 50 또는 200nmol/L의 아바트롬보팍을 마우스, 개, 또는 사람의 간 마이크로솜 0.2mg/mL와 함께 NADPH 존재 하에 37°C에서 30분간 배양했을 때, 아바트롬보팍 농도는 감소하지 않음.
segments.en_txt: • When avatrombopag at concentrations of 50 or 200 nmol/L was incubated with 0.2 mg/mL liver microsomes from mice, dogs, or humans in the presence of NADPH at 37°C for 30 minutes, no decrease in avatrombopag concentration was observed.

segments.ko_txt: • [14C]아바트롬보팍 경구투여 후 대변으로 배설된 방사능은 미변화 아바트롬보팍 및 대사체 3종이었으며, 투여 후 48시간까지 대변에서 검출된 미변화 아바트롬보팍은 투여량의 68.0%로, 대변 방사능의 주된 출처로 나타남.
segments.en_txt: • Following oral administration of [14C]-avatrombopag, the radioactivity excreted in feces consisted of unchanged avatrombopag and three metabolites. Up to 48 hours post-dose, unchanged avatrombopag accounted for 68.0% of the administered dose, indicating that unchanged avatrombopag was the primary component of fecal radioactivity.

segments.ko_txt: • 랫드와 사람에 [14C]아바트롬보팍을 경구투여했을 때 혈장 방사능은 주로 미변화 아바트롬보팍이었으며, 랫드 대변에서 검출된 방사능의 대부분 역시 미변화 아바트롬보팍으로 나타남.
segments.en_txt: • After oral administration of [14C]-avatrombopag to rats and humans, the majority of radioactivity in plasma was attributable to unchanged avatrombopag, and most of the radioactivity detected in rat feces was also from unchanged avatrombopag.

segments.ko_txt: • 간세포를 이용한 in vitro 대사 시험의 결과는 아바트롬보팍이 대사되어 여러 OH 대사체를 CYP 의존적으로 생성하며 또한 글루쿠로나이드 에스테르 1종을 생성함을 의미함.
segments.en_txt: • In vitro metabolism studies using hepatocytes indicated that avatrombopag is metabolized to several hydroxylated metabolites via CYP-dependent pathways and forms one glucuronide conjugate.

segments.ko_txt: 랫드의 in vivo 대사 시험의 결과를 통해 몇몇 산화적 대사 경로와 글리신 및 타우린 포합체가 확인됨.
segments.en_txt: In vivo metabolism studies in rats identified multiple oxidative metabolic pathways and the formation of glycine and taurine conjugates

segments.ko_txt: - 랫드에 [14C]아바트롬보팍을 경구투여했을 때 대변 시료 방사능의 대부분은 미변화 아바트롬보팍이었는데, 그 일부는 아바트롬보팍 포합체의 장내 가수분해에 의한 것일 수 있으며, 사람의 대변에서 주된 성분 2종은 미변화 아바트롬보팍과 OH 대사체였으나, 여러 포합체가 장에서 가수분해되었을 가능성을 배제할 수 없음.
segments.en_txt: - In rats, following oral administration of [14C]-avatrombopag, the majority of radioactivity detected in feces was due to unchanged avatrombopag, with some portion potentially resulting from intestinal hydrolysis of conjugated forms. In human feces, the two major components were unchanged avatrombopag and an OH metabolite; however, the possibility of hydrolysis of various conjugates in the intestine cannot be ruled out.

segments.ko_txt: - 랫드에 [14C]아바트롬보팍을 경구투여했을 때 대변 시료 방사능의 대부분은 미변화 아바트롬보팍이었는데, 그 일부는 아바트롬보팍 포합체의 장내 가수분해에 의한 것일 수 있으며, 사람의 대변에서 주된 성분 2종은 미변화 아바트롬보팍과 OH 대사체였으나, 여러 포합체가 장에서 가수분해되었을 가능성을 배제할 수 없음.
segments.en_txt: - In rats, following oral administration of [14C]-avatrombopag, the majority of radioactivity detected in feces was due to unchanged avatrombopag, with some portion potentially resulting from intestinal hydrolysis of conjugated forms. In human feces, the two major components were unchanged avatrombopag and an OH metabolite; however, the possibility of hydrolysis of various conjugates in the intestine cannot be ruled out.

segments.ko_txt: • 간 마이크로솜 또는 간세포와 함께 아바트로보팍을 배양한 후에서 대부분의 아바트로보팍이 잔존하여 사람에서의 초회통과 효과는 미미할 것으로 예상됨.
segments.en_txt: • Incubation of avatrombopag with liver microsomes or hepatocytes demonstrated that most avatrombopag remained unchanged, suggesting that the first-pass effect in humans is expected to be minimal.

segments.ko_txt: • 아바트롬보팍을 대사하는 CYP 효소는 주로 CYP3A4와 CYP2C9로 평가되었으며, 아바트롬보팍의 4-OH cis 대사체를 주로(76.2%) 생성하는 CYP 효소는 CYP2C9, 아바트롬보팍의 4-OH trans 대사체를 주로(82.9%) 생성하는 CYP 효소는 CYP3A4였음.
segments.en_txt: • The primary CYP enzymes involved in the metabolism of avatrombopag were identified as CYP3A4 and CYP2C9. CYP2C9 was responsible for the predominant formation (76.2%) of the 4-OH trans metabolite of avatrombopag, whereas CYP3A4 was primarily responsible (82.9%) for the formation of the 4-OH trans metabolite.

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍의 4-OH 대사체는 CYP2C9과 CYP3A4가 거의 같은 정도로 생성하였으며, 아바트롬보팍의 3-OH 대사체는 모든 배양 시험에서 미량으로 생성됨.
segments.en_txt: - The formation of the 4-OH metabolite of avatrombopag occurred at nearly equal levels via CYP2C9 and CYP3A4. The 3-OH metabolite was produced only in trace amounts in all incubation studies.

segments.ko_txt: • 아바트로보팍의 CYP(mRNA) 유도 가능성을 평가한 결과, 아바트롬보팍은 CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19을 유도하지 않았으며, CYP2B6와 CYP3A4는 약하게 유도하는 것으로 나타남.
segments.en_txt: • Evaluation of avatrombopag's potential to induce CYP enzymes (based on mRNA expression) demonstrated that avatrombopag did not induce CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, or CYP2C19, but weak induction was observed for CYP2B6 and CYP3A4.

segments.ko_txt: • 사람의 간 마이크로솜을 아바트롬보팍(0-10μmol/L) 및 CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A의 선택적 기질 각각과 함께 배양한 결과, 아바트롬보팍(0-10μmol/L)은 시험한 모든 CYP 효소를 유의하게 억제하지 않았으며, IC50는 모두 10μmol/L 이상임.
segments.en_txt: • When human liver microsomes were incubated with avatrombopag (0–10 μmol/L) along with selective substrates for CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A, avatrombopag did not significantly inhibit any of the tested CYP enzymes The IC50 values for all enzymes were ≥10 μmol/L.

segments.ko_txt: • 아바트롬보팍은 CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP3A에 대한 시간 의존적 억제(TDI)를 나타내지 않음.
segments.en_txt: • In addition, avatrombopag did not exhibit time-dependent inhibition (TDI) of CYP2C9, CYP2D6, or CYP3A.

segments.ko_txt: • 아바트롬보팍의 UGT1A1 및 UGT2B7 억제능을 간 마이크로솜을 이용하여 평가한 결과, 아바트롬보팍은 UGT1A1에 가역적 억제 효과를 나타냈으며, IC50는 9.47μmol/L.
segments.en_txt: • The inhibitory potential of avatrombopag on UGT1A1 and UGT2B7 was evaluated using liver microsomes Avatrombopag exhibited reversible inhibition of UGT1A1, with an IC50 value of 9.47 μmol/L.

segments.ko_txt: - UGT2B7에 대해서는, 아바트롬보팍은 시험한 농도(30 및 100μM) 중 최고 농도에서만 억제 활성을 보였으며 IC50를 산출할 수 없었음.
segments.en_txt: - For UGT2B7, inhibitory activity was observed only at the highest tested concentration among the tested concentrations (30 and 100 μM), and an IC50 value could not be determined.
5.4.4 Excretion (CTD 4.2.2.5)

segments.ko_txt: • 공복 상태의 수컷 랫드에 [14C]아바트롬보팍 1mg/kg을 경구투여 후 24시간에 소변과 대변의 방사능 누적 배설은 각각 투여량의 3.0% 및 48.5%였으며, 투여 후 168시간에는 각각 4.7% 및 87.4%로, 168시간까지 총 누적 배설량은 투여량의 92.1%로 나타남.
segments.en_txt: • In fasted male rats, following oral administration of [14C]-avatrombopag at a dose of 1 mg/kg, the cumulative excretion of radioactivity in urine and feces at 24 hours post-dose was 3.0% and 48.5% of the administered dose, respectively. By 168 hours post-dose, cumulative excretion had increased to 4.7% in urine and 87.4% in feces, resulting in a total recovery of 92.1% of the administered dose.

segments.ko_txt: • 단회 정맥 투여 후 담즙 배설량은 투여량의 45.6%, 대변과 소변의 평균 회수율은 투여량의 각각 11.1% 및 3.66%, 정맥투여한 방사능의 주요 제거 경로는 담즙 배설로 나타남.
segments.en_txt: • Following a single intravenous administration, biliary excretion accounted for 45.6% of the administered dose. The average recovery of radioactivity in feces and urine was 11.1% and 3.66%, respectively. These results indicate that the primary elimination route for intravenously administered radioactivity is biliary excretion.

segments.ko_txt: • BDC 랫드에 경구 및 정맥 투여한 결과는 간에서의 제거와 담즙 배설이 흡수된 방사능의 주요 제거 경로임을 암시함.
segments.en_txt: • The results from both oral and intravenous administration studies in BDC rats suggest that hepatic clearance and biliary excretion are the primary elimination pathways for absorbed radioactivity.

segments.ko_txt: • 수유하는 SD 랫드에 [14C]아바트롬보팍 3mg/kg를 단회 경구투여한 후 모유의 방사능 농도-시간 프로파일과 그 PK 파라미터는 혈장과 유사하여, 혈장 대비 모유의 방사능 AUC(0-inf)의 비는 0.94로, 모유와 혈장의 방사능의 주요 성분은 아바트롬보팍이었는데, 이는 아바트롬보팍이 모유로 분비됨을 시사함.
segments.en_txt: • In lactating SD rats, following a single oral administration of [14C]-avatrombopag at a dose of 3 mg/kg, the concentration–time profiles and pharmacokinetic parameters of radioactivity in milk were similar to those observed in plasma. The ratio of the AUC(0-inf) of radioactivity in milk to that in plasma was 0.94. The primary radioactive component detected in both milk and plasma was unchanged avatrombopag, indicating that avatrombopag is excreted into breast milk.

segments.ko_txt: • 수유하는 SD 랫드에 [14C]아바트롬보팍 3mg/kg를 단회 경구투여한 후 모유의 방사능 농도-시간 프로파일과 그 PK 파라미터는 혈장과 유사하여, 혈장 대비 모유의 방사능 AUC(0-inf)의 비는 0.94로, 모유와 혈장의 방사능의 주요 성분은 아바트롬보팍이었는데, 이는 아바트롬보팍이 모유로 분비됨을 시사함.
segments.en_txt: • In lactating SD rats, following a single oral administration of [14C]-avatrombopag at a dose of 3 mg/kg, the concentration–time profiles and pharmacokinetic parameters of radioactivity in milk were similar to those observed in plasma. The ratio of the AUC(0-inf) of radioactivity in milk to that in plasma was 0.94. The primary radioactive component detected in both milk and plasma was unchanged avatrombopag, indicating that avatrombopag is excreted into breast milk.

segments.ko_txt: • 랫드 담즙에서 미변화 아바트롬보팍과 아바트롬보팍 포합체가 발견되었으며, 랫드와 사람의 대변에서 검출된 방사능의 대부분은 미변화 아바트롬보팍이었음.
segments.en_txt: • Unchanged avatrombopag and avatrombopag conjugates were detected in rat bile. The majority of radioactivity detected in feces from both rats and humans was attributable to unchanged avatrombopag.

segments.ko_txt: - 이는 대부분의 포접체가 가수분해되어 위장관에 미변화 아바트롬보팍을 방출하였음을 암시함.
segments.en_txt: - These findings suggest that most conjugates were hydrolyzed in the gastrointestinal tract, releasing unchanged avatrombopag.

segments.ko_txt: - in vivo에서 미변화 아바트롬보팍이 장-간 순환을 거칠 가능성이 있었으나, 사람과 동물의 혈장 농도-시간 프로파일에서는 유의한 장-간 순환을 거치는 화합물에서 전형적으로 나타나는 복수의 피크가 나타나지 않았으므로 아바트롬보팍은 유의한 장-간 순환을 거치지 않음.
segments.en_txt: - Although unchanged avatrombopag had the potential to undergo enterohepatic circulation in vivo, plasma concentration–time profiles in both humans and animals did not exhibit multiple peaks, which are characteristic of compounds undergoing significant enterohepatic recirculation. Therefore, it is concluded that avatrombopag does not undergo substantial enterohepatic circulation.

segments.en_txt: • Efficacy studies: in vitro, in vivo efficacy data were submitted. segments.ko_txt: • (안전성 약리) 중추신경계, 호흡기계, 심혈관계에서는 이상 영향은 없었으며, 신장/비뇨기계에서 바람직하지 않을 가능성이 있는 약력학적 효과가 확인됨.
segments.en_txt: • Safety pharmacology studies: No adverse effects were observed in the central nervous, respiratory, and cardiovascular systems, but potentially undesirable pharmacological effects were identified in the renal/urinary system.

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍은 hERG 채널을 IC50 1.4μmol/L(0.91μg/mL)로 억제하였으나, 원격측정장치를 장착한 비글견에서 최대 300mg/kg(TK수행 Cmax 암수 평균: 9,227ng/mL 유리형 2.1% 0.194μg/mL)까지 심혈관계에 영향을 미치지 않음. CLD 임상 권장 최대용량인 60mg 노출(Cmax 352.2ng/mL의 유리형 12ng/mL)의 16배에 해당되어 임상에서의 안전성 우려는 미미할 것으로 예상됨
segments.en_txt: Avatrombopag inhibited the hERG potassium channel with an IC50 of 1.4 μmol/L (0.91 μg/mL). However, in telemetry-monitored beagle dogs, avatrombopag did not affect cardiovascular parameters even at a maximum administered dose of 300 mg/kg (TK Cmax mean values for males and females: 9,227 ng/mL; with a free fraction of 2.1%, resulting in a free drug concentration of 0.194 μg/mL). At the clinically recommended maximum dose of 60 mg for patients with CLD, the Cmax was 352.2 ng/mL, corresponding to a free drug concentration of 12 ng/mL. This exposure is approximately 16-fold lower than the highest exposure observed in beagle dogs. Therefore, the risk of cardiovascular toxicity during clinical use is considered minimal.

segments.ko_txt: - 개 4주 반복투여시험에서 관찰된 신장 관련 징후가 신장/비뇨기계에 대한 영향 평가 300mg/kg에서 유사하게 관찰됨(독성에 대한 심사자 의견 참조).
segments.en_txt: In a 4-week repeated-dose toxicity study in dogs, renal-related findings were observed, which were consistent with findings detected at 300 mg/kg in a separate renal/urinary system toxicity evaluation. (Refer to the reviewer’s comments on toxicity for additional details.)

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍은 주로 CYP2C9 및 3A4에 의해 대사되므로 2C9 및 3A4 저해제와의 상호작용 확인이 필요하여 임상에서 Fluconazole(CYP2C9 및 CYP3A의 moderate 저해제), Itraconazole (강력한 CYP3A 저해제), 또는 Rifampin(강력한 CYP3A 유도제 및 Moderate CYP2C9 유도제)과의 상호작용을 건강한 자원자를 대상으로 실시하였으며, 용법용량 항에 반영됨.
segments.en_txt: - Since avatrombopag is primarily metabolized by CYP2C9 and CYP3A4, it was necessary to assess potential drug interactions with inhibitors and inducers of these enzymes. Clinical drug interaction studies were conducted in healthy volunteers using fluconazole (a moderate inhibitor of CYP2C9 and CYP3A), itraconazole (a strong CYP3A inhibitor), and rifampin (a strong CYP3A inducer and moderate CYP2C9 inducer). The results of these studies have been incorporated into the Dosage and Administration section of the clinical guidelines.

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍의 대사체 4-OH는 혈장에서 검출되지 않고 대변에서 검출됨.
segments.en_txt: - The 4-OH metabolite of avatrombopag was not detected in plasma but was detected in feces.

segments.ko_txt: - 임신한 랫드에 [14C]아바트롬보팍을 경구투여한 결과, 태자 및 태자 혈장에서 아바트롬보팍 방사능이 검출되었으며, 수유 중인 랫드의 유즙으로 아바트롬보팍이 배설됨. 임상시험에서 임부, 수유부가 포함되지 않았고, 동 사항을 사용상의주의사항 ‘7. 임부, 수유부, 가임여성 및 남성의 생식 가능성에 대한 투여’, ‘13. 전문가를 위한 정보’, ‘4) 비임상시험 정보’에 반영하였음.
segments.en_txt: - Following oral administration of [14C]-avatrombopag to pregnant rats, radioactivity derived from avatrombopag was detected in both fetuses and fetus plasma. In addition, avatrombopag was excreted into the breast milk of lactating rats.

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍은 in vitro P-gp 기질인 것으로 평가되어 임상에서 P-gp 억제제 사이클로스포린 또는 베라파밀과 병용투여시험을 수행하였으며 유의한 노출 증가가 관찰되지 않아 병용 시 용량 조절이 필요하지 않은 것으로 판단하였고, 동 사항을 사용상의주의사항 13.
segments.en_txt: -     Avatrombopag has been evaluated in vitro as a substrate of P-gp, leading to clinical drug interaction studies with P-gp inhibitors such as cyclosporine and verapamil.

segments.en_txt: The study results showed no significant increase in avatrombopag exposure. ⇒ This finding has been reflected in the "Information for Healthcare Professionals" section.

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍은 in vitro에서 수송체 OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3를 각각 IC50 2.8, 0.7 및 0.2μM로 억제하는 것으로 관찰되었으며 임상 최대 권장용량 60mg 노출(Cmax 352.2ng/mL의 유리형 12ng/mL) 대비 각각 152배, 38배 및 11배 안전역을 나타냄.
segments.en_txt: -Avatrombopag was observed in vitro to inhibit the transporters OATP1B3, OAT1, and OAT3 with IC50 values of 2.8, 0.7, and 0.2 μM, respectively. These values correspond to safety margins of 152-fold, 38-fold, and 11-fold, respectively, when compared to the exposure at the maximum recommended clinical dose of 60 mg (Cmax of 352.2 ng/mL, with a free drug concentration of 12 ng/mL).

segments.en_txt: • The pharmacological activity of Avatrombopag appears to be very species-specific, and only able to activate chimpanzee and human. Therefore, while non-clinical studies using other animal species cannot fully predict pharmacological potential risks. However, the submitted non-clinical study data provided adequately support the safety and efficacy of avatrombopag.

segments.ko_txt: 막투과성도 낮아 ICH M9 생물약제학 분류시스템(BCS) 상 분류는 class IV로 낮은용해도, 낮은투과성으로 분류됨
segments.en_txt: Avatrombopag also shows low permeability and is classified as a BCS Class IV compound under the ICH M9 biopharmaceutics classification system, indicating low solubility and low permeability.

segments.ko_txt: - 사람에서 아바트롬보팍의 절대 경구 BA는 알려지지 않았으나, 14C-아바트롬보팍을 이용한 흡수, 분포, 대사, 배설(ADME) 시험(501-PK-901)에서 아바트롬보팍 투여량의 44% 이상이 흡수되는 것으로 나타남
segments.en_txt: - The absolute oral BA of avatrombopag in humans is not known, but in absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion (ADME) studies using [14C]-avatrombopag (study 501-PK-901), it was shown that more than 44% of the administered dose of avatrombopag is absorbed.

segments.ko_txt: - 음식과 함께 아바트롬보팍 2G 정제 제형을 섭취했을 때 아바트롬보팍 PK의 변화를 평가하는 임상시험(E5501-G000-010 및 E5501-A001-017)에서, 음식(저지방식이 및 고지방식이)은 아바트롬보팍 흡수 속도나 정도에 영향을 미치지 않았으나 Cmax 및 AUC(0-inf)의 개인 내 변동성 및 개인 간 변동성(IIV)는 유의하게 낮아졌음(약 50%). 이러한 효과는 함께 섭취한 음식의 종류(즉, 저지방식이 및 고지방식이)에 무관하였음
segments.en_txt: - In clinical studies to evaluate the changes in PK of avatrombopag 2G tablet formulation with food intake (E5501-G000-010 and E5501-A001-017), food (both low-fat and high-fat meals) did not affect the absorption rate or extent of avatrombopag. However, the intra-subject variability (CV) and inter- subject variability (IIV) of Cmax and AUC(0-inf) were significantly reduced (by about 50%). This effect was independent of the type of food consumed (i.e., low-fat or high-fat meals).

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍의 혈장 단백 결합률은 0.05~50μg/mL 범위에서는 농도와 무관하였으며, 사람에서는 비교적 높아 96.3%-96.6% 범위였음
segments.en_txt: - The plasma protein binding of avatrombopag was concentration-independent within the range of 0.05–50 μg/mL and was relatively high in humans, ranging from 96.3% to 96.6%.

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍의 적혈구 분배율 평가 결과 1/3은 적혈구에, 2/3는 혈장에 존재하였고, 적혈구에서의 농도가 혈장 농도의 50%임음 의미
segments.en_txt: - Evaluation of avatrombopag’s erythrocyte distribution revealed that approximately one-third was present in erythrocytes and two-thirds in plasma. The concentration in erythrocytes was about 50% of that in plasma.

segments.ko_txt: - 집단약동학 분석을 통해 추정한 아바트롬보팍 V/F는 180L로, 14C-ADME 시험에서 경구 BA가 44% 이상이었음을 고려하면, V/F가 높다는 것은 세포 내에 광범위하게 분포함을 의미함
segments.en_txt: - The estimated apparent volume of distribution (V/F) of avatrombopag from population PK analysis is 180 L. Given that the oral bioavailability (BA) in the 14C-ADME study exceeded 44%, this high V/F suggests extensive distribution of avatrombopag into tissues and cells.

segments.en_txt: • Metabolism and Excretion

segments.ko_txt: - 건강한 성인 남성 대상 14C-ADME 시험 결과(501-PK-901), 총 방사능의 약 88%는 대변에서, 6%는 소변에서 회수되었고, 호흡에서는 방사능이 측정되지 않았음. 아바트롬보팍의 주요 배설 경로는 대변이었으며, 혈장에서는 미변화체만 검출되었음. 대변에서 측정된 방사능 88% 중 43.8%는 대사체인 4-OH 아바트롬보팍이었으며, 33.5%는 아바트롬보팍이었음.
segments.en_txt: - In the 14C-ADME study (501-PK-901) conducted in healthy adult males, approximately 88% of avatrombopag was excreted in the feces and about 6% in the urine, indicating that fecal excretion is the primary route of excretion. Of the 88% of the drug-related materials found in the feces, 77.3% was avatrombopag (33.5%) and its metabolite 4-Oh-avatrombopag (43.8%).

segments.ko_txt: - 약물을 대사하는 주요 CYP(CYP3A4, CYP2D6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8) 중 간에서 아바트롬보팍의 산화적 대사를 담당하는 것은 CYP3A4와 CYP2C9였으며, CYP3A4는 4-OH trans 대사체를, CYP2C9는 4-OH cis 대사체를 주로 생성하였음 -> 만성 ITP 환자의 용법용량에 CYP3A4/CYP2C9 중등도 또는 강력한 이중억제제와 병용투여 시 용량조절 하도록 설정
segments.en_txt: - Among the major cytochrome P450 enzymes involved in drug metabolism (CYP3A4, CYP2D6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8), CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 were primarily responsible for the oxidative metabolism of avatrombopag in the liver. CYP3A4 mainly produced the 4-OH trans metabolite, while CYP2C9 primarily generated the 4-OH cis metabolite. -> Dosage adjustment was required when co-administered with moderate or strong CYP3A4/CYP2C9 dual inhibitors in patients with chronic ITP

segments.en_txt: • Age, gender, and weight

segments.ko_txt: 1 CLD 환자를 대상으로 수행한 2상 시험(202)의 집단약동학 분석 결과(CPMS-E5501- 001R-v3.0), 연령, 체중, 또는 성별은 아바트롬보팍 PK에 영향을 미치지 않았으며, 1상, 2상 및 3상 시험의 자료를 통합하여 수행한 최종적 집단약동학 분석(CPMS-E5501-005R-v1.0)에서도 유사한 결과가 확인됨
segments.en_txt: 1 Results from the population pharmacokinetic analysis of the Phase 2 study (202) conducted in CLD patients (CPMS-E5501-001R-v3.0) indicated that age, weight, and gender did not influence the PK of avatrombopag. Similar results were confirmed in the final population pharmacokinetic analysis (CPMS-E5501-005R-v1.0), which was conducted based on combined data from Phase 1, 2, and 3 studies.

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍 V/F에 유의한 영향을 주는 것으로 보이는 공변량은 체중과 만성 간질환이었으나, CLD 환자에서의 시뮬레이션 결과에서는 체중이 2배가 되어도 아바트롬보팍 노출과 혈소판 수 증가에 미치는 영향은 미미한 것으로 나타남
segments.en_txt: -The covariates that appeared to significantly affect avatrombopag V/F were weight and chronic liver disease, but in the simulation results in patients with CLD, the effect on avatrombopag exposure and platelet count increase was minimal even when weight doubled.

segments.ko_txt: 2 건강한 시험대상자 및 ITP 환자의 아바트롬보팍 PK 모델에서, 연령과 성별은 아바트롬보팍의 PK에 영향을 미치지 않았음.
segments.en_txt: 2In the avatrombopag PK model of healthy subjects and patients with ITP, age and gender did not affect the PK of avatrombopag.

segments.en_txt: Simulation of the effect of body weight (55 kg, 110 kg) on ​​platelet count showed that the effect of body weight on platelet count was very small in this weight range.

segments.ko_txt: • 인종
segments.en_txt: • Race

segments.ko_txt: 1 CLD 환자에서의 집단약동학 및 PK/PD 분석의 일부로, 인종이 아바트롬보팍의 PK와 PD에 미치는 영향을 평가한 결과, 인종은 아바트롬보팍의 겉보기 청소율에 대해 통계적으로 유의한 공변량이 아니었음
segments.en_txt: 1 As part of the population PK and PK/PD analyses in patients with CLD, the effect of race on the PK and PD of avatrombopag was evaluated, and race was not a statistically significant covariate for the apparent clearance of avatrombopag.

segments.ko_txt: - 통합 분석 자료에 787명 포함: 백인 522명, 흑인/아프리카계 미국인 59명, 중국인/일본인/한국인이 아닌 아시아인 13명, 일본인 74명, 중국인 34명, 한국인 29명, 미국계 인디언 1명, 기타 인종이 21명
segments.en_txt: -787 subjects were included in the pooled analysis data. 522 Whites, 59 Blacks/African Americans, 13 Asians other than Chinese/Japanese/Koreans, 74 Japanese, 34 Chinese, 29 Koreans, 1 American Indian, and 21 from other races

segments.ko_txt: - 확증적 3상 시험의 1차 및 2차 평가변수를 인종별로 분석한 결과, 통합된 효능 분석에서 백인과 동아시아인 간의 시술 당일 베이스라인 대비 혈소판 수의 평균 변화량은 40mg 용법과 60mg 용법에서 각각 유사하였음.
segments.en_txt: -According to the analysis of primary and secondary endpoints of the pivotal phase 3 study by race, the pooled efficacy analysis showed that the mean change in platelet count from baseline on the day of the procedure between white subjects and East Asians was similar for the 40 mg and 60 mg regimens, respectively.

segments.ko_txt: 1차 평가변수 평가 또는 시술 당일 베이스라인 대비 혈소판 수 평균 변화량 분석에서, 인종은 유의한 영향을 미치지 않았음.
segments.en_txt: In the primary endpoint evaluation or the analysis of the mean change in platelet count from baseline on the day of the procedure, race did not have a significant effect.

segments.ko_txt: 전체 인구 집단과 비교하여 동아시아인에서 용량을 조절할 필요는 없었음
segments.en_txt: No dose adjustment was required in East Asians compared to the overall population.

segments.ko_txt: 2 건강한 시험대상자 및 ITP 환자의 집단약동학 분석 결과 아바트롬보팍 PK 모델에서 연령과 성별은 아바트롬인종이 아바트롬보팍 PK에 유의한 영향을 미치지 않았음.
segments.en_txt: 2 According to the population PK Analysis of healthy subjects and patients with ITP, the avatrombopag PK model showed that race did not have a significant effect on the PK of avatrombopag.

segments.en_txt: There was no need to adjust the avatrombopag dose according to the patient's race.

segments.ko_txt: 2 건강한 시험대상자 및 ITP 환자의 집단약동학 분석 결과 아바트롬보팍 PK 모델에서 연령과 성별은 아바트롬인종이 아바트롬보팍 PK에 유의한 영향을 미치지 않았음.

segments.ko_txt: • 유전적 다형성
segments.en_txt: • Genetic polymorphism

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍의 대사에 영향을 미칠 수 있는 유전적 다형성이 있다고 알려져 있는 효소와 수송체는 P-gp, CYP2C9, CYP3A4였으며, 아바트롬보팍의 PK에 미치는 영향을 DDI 시험을 포함한 일부 1상 시험에서 평가하였음
segments.en_txt: - Enzymes and transporters with known genetic polymorphism that may influence the metabolism of avatrombopag include P-gp, CYP2C9, and CYP3A4. Their effects on the PK of avatrombopag were evaluated in several Phase 1 studies, including the DDI study.

segments.ko_txt: - 008 시험에서 ABCB1 유전자의 7개 DNA 서열 변동성을 분석하여 P-gp의 유전적 다양성을 평가한 결과, 검사한 서열 변동성 중 아바트롬보팍 PK 파라미터와 유의한 관련이 있는 것은 없었음
segments.en_txt: -Evaluation of the genetic diversity of P-gp conducted by analyzing seven DNA sequences of the ABCB1 gene in Study 008 showed that none of the tested sequence variants were significantly related to the PK parameters of avatrombopag.

segments.ko_txt: - 018 시험과 019 시험의 시험대상자군에 대사 저하자가 적어서 CYP2C9 유전자형이 상호작용의 정도에 미치는 영향에 대해 결론을 내릴 수 없었음
segments.en_txt: -      There were limited poor metabolizers in the study populations for Study 018 and Study 019, the impact of genotype on the extent of interaction could not be concluded.

segments.ko_txt: - CYP3A4에서는 유전자형과 상호작용의 정도 사이에 관련성은 없는 것으로 보였음
segments.en_txt: -No correlation was observed between CYP3A4 genotype and the level of interaction.

segments.ko_txt: - CYP3A4에서는 유전자형과 상호작용의 정도 사이에 관련성은 없는 것으로 보였음
segments.en_txt: -No correlation was observed between CYP3A4 genotype and the level of interaction.

segments.ko_txt: • 간기능 장애 ☞ 건강한 사람과 비교하여 간장애 환자에서 투여량을 조절할 필요 없음
segments.en_txt: • No dose adjustment is required in patients with hepatic impairment compared to healthy subjects

segments.ko_txt: - CLD 개발 프로그램의 2상 및 3상 시험의 통합 데이터세트를 이용한 집단약동학 분석의일부로 간장애가 아바트롬보팍에 미치는 영향을 평가하였음
segments.en_txt: -The effect of hepatic impairment on avatrombopag was evaluated as part of the population PK analysis using the pooled dataset from phase 2 and 3 studies of the CLD development program.

segments.ko_txt: - 집단약동학 및 PK/PD 데이터세트에는 CTP(Child-turcotte-pugh) 점수가 5-12점(경증~중증)인 환자 394명이 포함되고, 이 환자군에서 이에 해당되는 MELD 점수는 4-23점이었음
segments.en_txt: -The population PK and PK/PD dataset included 394 patients with a Child-Turcotte-Pugh (CTP) score of 5-12 (mild to severe), and the corresponding MELD score in this patient population was 4-23.

segments.ko_txt: - CLD 환자(Child-turcotte-pugh 점수가 5-12점(경증~중증))는 건강한 사람에 비해 V/F가 약 65% 더 높았으나, CL/F에는 영향이 없었으므로 아바트롬보팍의 총 혈장 노출은 CLD 환자와 건강한 사람 간에 유사하였음
segments.en_txt: -Patients with CLD (Child-Turcotte-Pugh score 5-12 (mild to severe)) had approximately 65% ​​higher V/F than healthy subjects, but CL/F was not affected, so the total plasma exposure of avatrombopag was similar between patients with CLD and healthy subjects.

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍 CL/F와 CTP 점수 및 MELD 점수의 관계에서, 중증의 간장애 환자를 포함하는 간장애의 범위에서 건강한 사람과 CL/F가 유사하였음
segments.en_txt: -In the relationship between avatrombopag CL/F, CTP score and MELD score, CL/F was similar to healthy subjects across the spectrum of hepatic impairment, including patients with severe hepatic impairment.

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍 CL/F와 CTP 점수 및 MELD 점수의 관계에서, 중증의 간장애 환자를 포함하는 간장애의 범위에서 건강한 사람과 CL/F가 유사하였음
segments.en_txt: -In the relationship between avatrombopag CL/F, CTP score and MELD score, CL/F was similar to healthy subjects across the spectrum of hepatic impairment, including patients with severe hepatic impairment.

segments.ko_txt: • 신기능 장애 ☞ 건강한 사람과 비교하여 신장애 환자에서 투여량을 조절할 필요 없음
segments.en_txt: • No dose adjustment is required in patients with renal impairment compared to healthy subjects.

segments.ko_txt: - 방사성 표지물질을 이용한 14C-ADME 시험(501-PK-901)의 결과는 아바트롬보팍이 광범위하게 대사되지 않으며 투여량 중 6%만이 소변에서 회수된 것으로 보아 전체 청소율 중 신장 경로가 차지하는 상대적 비율이 그리 많지 않을 것으로 예상됨
segments.en_txt: -Results of Study 14C-ADME(501-PK-901) using radiolabeled indicated that avatrombopag is not extensively metabolized and only 6% of the administered dose was recovered in urine, suggesting that the relative proportion of the renal route in total clearance is not significant.

segments.ko_txt: - CLD 환자에서의 집단약동학 및 PK/PD 분석의 일부로, 혈청 크레아티닌과 추정 사구체여과율(eGFR; MDRD 공식으로 산출)로 신장애가 아바트롬보팍에 미치는 영향을 평가하였음
segments.en_txt: -As part of the population pharmacokinetic and PK/PD analysis in patients with CLD, the impact of renal impairment on avatrombopag was evaluated using serum creatinine and estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR; calculated using the MDRD formula).

segments.ko_txt: - 집단약동학 데이터세트에는 건강한 사람 391명과 CLD 환자 396명이 포함되었으며, 집단약동학 데이터세트에서 크레아티닌 청소율과 eGFR은 각각 25.6-509 mL/min 및 29.9-208 mL/min로 대부분은 경증 또는 중등증의 신장애가 있었음
segments.en_txt: -The population PK dataset included 391 healthy subjects and 396 patients with CLD. In the population PK dataset, creatinine clearance and eGFR ranged from 25.6 to 509 mL/min and 29.9 to 208 mL/min, respectively, with most patients having mild or moderate renal impairment.

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍 청소율과 크레아티닌 청소율 및 eGFR 간의 상관관계는 없었음
segments.en_txt: -There was no correlation between avatrombopag clearance and creatinine clearance and eGFR.

segments.en_txt: Effect of co-administration of medications on the PK of avatrombopag

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍은 광범위하게 대사되지 않고, 간에서 아바트롬보팍의 산화적 대사를 담당하는 것은 CYP3A4와 CYP2C9였음.
segments.en_txt: -Avatrombopag is not extensively metabolized, and CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 are responsible for the oxidative metabolism of avatrombopag in the liver.

segments.ko_txt: MDR1을 과발현하는 MDCK II 세포를 이용한 in vitro 시험에서 아바트롬보팍은 P-gp 수송체의 기질으로 확인됨
segments.en_txt: In vitro studies using MDCK II cells overexpressing MDR1 confirmed that avatrombopag is a substrate of the P-gp transporter.

segments.ko_txt: - (E5501-G000-008) 강한 P-gp 억제제(항정상태의 베라파밀 240mg과 단회투여한 사이클로스포린 A 400mg)와 아바트롬보팍 2G 정제 병용투여 결과, 아바트롬보팍의 전신 노출에 상대적으로 약한 영향을 미쳤으며, 특히 사이클로스포린 A는 아바트롬보팍과 병용투여 시 임상적으로 중요한 영향이 없었음
segments.en_txt: -(E5501-G000-008) Co-administration of strong P-gp inhibitors (verapamil 240 mg at steady state and a single dose of cyclosporin A 400 mg) with avatrombopag 2G tablets had a relatively weak effect on the systemic exposure of avatrombopag. In particular, cyclosporin A had no clinically significant effect when co-administered with avatrombopag.

segments.ko_txt: - (E5501-A001-019) 아바트롬보팍과 CYP2C9 및 CYP3A 조절제의 병용투여 결과, 이트라코나졸보다 플루코나졸이나 리팜핀 병용 시 아바트롬보팍 전신 노출에 유의한 변화가 있었음.
segments.en_txt: -(E5501-A001-019) Co-administration of avatrombopag with CYP2C9 and CYP3A modifiers showed that there is a significant change in the systemic exposure of avatrombopag when co-administered with fluconazole or rifampicin instead of itraconazole.

segments.ko_txt: in vivo에서 아바트롬보팍의 대사에는 CYP3A4보다는 CYP2C9이 주된 역할을 나타냄을 의미함
segments.en_txt: It means that in vivo, CYP2C9 plays a major role in the metabolism of avatrombopag rather than CYP3A4.

segments.ko_txt: - CLD 환자의 집단약동학 분석(CPMS-E5501-005R-v1.0)을 통해 공변량을 분석하여 양성자 펌프 억제제나 H2 차단제의 병용투여가 아바트롬보팍의 청소율이나 AUC에 영향을 미치는지 평가하였음.
segments.en_txt: -Covariates were analyzed through the population PK analysis of patients with CLD (CPMS-E5501-005R-v1.0) to evaluate whether co-administration of proton pump inhibitors or H2 blockers affects the clearance or AUC of avatrombopag.

segments.ko_txt: 집단약동학 데이터세트에 포함된 787명의 시험대상자 중 173명은 양성자 펌프 억제제를, 18명은 H2 차단제를, 10명은 제산제를 병용하였음.
segments.en_txt: Of the 787 subjects included in the population pharmacokinetic dataset, 173 were co-administered with proton pump inhibitors, 18 with H2 blockers, and 10 with antacids.

segments.ko_txt: 분석 결과, 위장 산도 저하제와 아바트롬보팍의 상대적 투여 시점에 관한 자료는 없지만, 위장 산도 저하제를 병용하여도 아바트롬보팍의 항정상태 PK에는 영향이 없는 것으로 나타남
segments.en_txt: As a result of the analysis, although there is no data on the relative timing of administering gastric acid depressant and avatrombopag, co-administration of gastric acid depressant did not affect the steady-state PK of avatrombopag.

segments.ko_txt: - 1G 정제의 아바트롬보팍 100 mg 단회투여가 QTc 간격에 미치는 효과를 평가하는 QT 정밀평가시험(E5501-A001-001 시험) 결과, QTc 간격에 미치는 영향은 없었음
segments.en_txt: - In the thorough QT study (E5501-A001-001) evaluating the effect of a single 100 mg dose of avatrombopag (1G tablet) on the QTc interval, the results confirmed no impact on the QTc interval.

segments.ko_txt: - CLD 환자의 3상 시험의 자료를 포함하여 202 시험, 204 시험, 310 시험, 311 시험의 시험대상자 395명으로부터 확보한 ddQTcF(msec) 자료로 통합적인 PK-QTcF 간격 분석을 시행하였음. 아바트롬보팍 농도 증가에 따른 ddQTcF 간격의 회귀직선 기울기는 0.000964msec/μg/mL(95% CI: -0.00870~0.0106)로 회귀직선의 95%CI 상한은 10msec보다 낮은 값으로 QTc 간격을 연장시킬 위험은 확인되지 않았음
segments.en_txt: - A integrated PK-QTcF interval analysis was conducted using ddQTcF (msec) data from 395 subjects in Study 202, Study 204, Study 310, and Study 311, including data from Phase 3 studies in patients with CLD (for details, see Section 6.4.4. Population Pharmacokinetics Study, CPMS-E5501-005R-v1.0). The slope of the regression line for ddQTcF interval as a function of avatrombopag concentration was 0.000964 msec/μg/mL (95% CI: -0.00870 to 0.0106). The upper bound of the 95% CI for the regression line was below 10 msec, indicating that avatrombopag does not pose a risk of QTc interval prolongation.

segments.ko_txt: - 모델로 예측한 아바트롬보팍 농도와, 202 시험, 204 시험, 310 시험, 311 시험에서 CLD 환자에 아바트롬보팍 투여 후 ddQTcF 간격의 상관관계에서도 기울기 파라미터의 95% CI가 1을 포함하였는데, 이는 아바트롬보팍 농도가 증가에 따른 ddQTcF 간격의 유의한 변화가 없음을 의미함
segments.en_txt: - In the model-predicted correlation analysis between avatrombopag concentration and ddQTcF interval in patients with CLD from Study 202, Study 204, Study 310, and Study 311, the 95% CI for the slope parameter included 1, confirming that there was no significant change in ddQTcF interval with increasing avatrombopag concentration.

segments.ko_txt: • CLD가 있는 시험대상자의 혈소판감소증 치료에서 아바트롬보팍(40mg 또는 60mg을 5일 동안 경구 투여)이 위약보다 우월함을 입증하였음
segments.en_txt: • Avatrombopag (40 mg or 60 mg administered orally for 5 days) demonstrated superiority over placebo in the treatment of thrombocytopenia in adult patients with chronic liver disease scheduled for a procedure.

segments.ko_txt: - 확증적 효능 자료의 근거가 된 2건의 확증적 3상 시험(310 시험 및 311 시험)에서,
segments.en_txt: - Based on 2 pivotal Phase 3 studies (Study 310 and Study 311) that provided pivotal efficacy data:

segments.ko_txt: · 아바트롬보팍 치료 후 무작위배정 후 및 예정된 시술을 받고 최대 7일 후에 발생한 출혈로 인한 혈소판 수혈이나 구조 시술이 필요하지 않은 시험대상자의 비율이 임상적으로 의미 있고 통계적으로 유의하게 증가하였음
segments.en_txt: · The proportion of subjects who did not require platelet transfusion or rescue intervention due to bleeding up to 7 days after receiving the scheduled procedure following avatrombopag treatment showed a clinically meaningful and statistically significant increase.

segments.ko_txt: · 시술일 혈소판 수가 50×109/L 이상인 시험대상자의 비율이 유의성 있게 증가하였음
segments.en_txt: · The proportion of subjects with platelet counts ≥50×109/L on the procedure day significantly increased.

segments.ko_txt: · 시술일 혈소판 수가 50×109/L 이상인 시험대상자의 비율이 유의성 있게 증가하였음
segments.en_txt: · The proportion of subjects with platelet counts ≥50×109/L on the procedure day significantly increased.

segments.ko_txt: · 이러한 효과는 하위군에 대해 일관된 결과를 나타내었음
segments.en_txt: · These effects showed consistent results across subgroups.

segments.ko_txt: • ITP 환자의 혈소판감소증 치료에서 아바트롬보팍이 위약보다 우월함을 입증하였음
segments.en_txt: • Avatrombopag demonstrated superiority to placebo in the treatment of thrombocytopenia in adult patients with chronic immune thrombocytopenia.

segments.ko_txt: - 확증적 효능 자료의 근거가 된 1건의 확증적 3상 시험(302 시험)에서
segments.en_txt: - Based on a single pivotal Phase 3 study (Study 302) that provided pivotal efficacy data:

segments.ko_txt: · 아바트롬보팍 20 mg QD 시작 용량 및 용량 적정을 통해 구제요법이 없는 상태에서 6개월의 치료 기간 동안(즉, 방문 3~22 포함) 혈소판 수가 50 x 109/L 이상인 누적 주 수로 정의되는 혈소판 반응의 누적 주수 및 및 8일차에의 혈소판 반응(50×109/L 이상)을 보인 시험대상자의 비율이 임상적으로 의미 있고 통계적으로 유의하게 증가하였음
segments.en_txt: · Avatrombopag 20 mg QD as the starting dose with dose titration resulted in a clinically meaningful and statistically significant increase in both the cumulative weeks of platelet response (≥50×109/L) during the 6-month treatment period (i.e., including Visits 3 to 22) without rescue therapy and the proportion of subjects achieving a platelet response (≥50×109/L) on Day 8.

segments.ko_txt: • 안전성 분석대상군
segments.en_txt: • Safety Analysis Set

segments.ko_txt: - 핵심 3상 임상시험 2건(310 및 311)에 총 435명이 무작위배정되었고, 이 중 430명을 시험약을 최소 1회 투여받고 투여후 안전성 평가를 최소 1회 받은 안전성 분석대상군에 포함
segments.en_txt: - A total of 435 subjects were randomized in the 2 pivotal Phase 3 studies (310 and 311). Among them, 430 subjects who received at least 1 dose of the study drug and had at least 1 post-treatment safety assessment were included in the safety analysis population.

segments.ko_txt: - 안전성 분석대상군 430명 중 아바트롬보팍 투여군은 274명, 위약 투여군은 156명임
segments.en_txt: - Of these 430 subjects, 274 were in the avatrombopag group, and 156 were in the placebo group.

segments.ko_txt: - 안전성 분석대상군 430명 중 아바트롬보팍 투여군은 274명, 위약 투여군은 156명임
segments.en_txt: - Of these 430 subjects, 274 were in the avatrombopag group, and 156 were in the placebo group.

segments.ko_txt: • 시험 완료 및 중지
segments.en_txt: • Study Completion and Discontinuation

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍 투여군에서는 4.4%(12/275명), 위약 투여군에서는 시험대상자의 6.4% (10/156명)이 시험을 중단하였음
segments.en_txt: - Study discontinuation rates were 4.4% (12/275 subjects) in the avatrombopag group and 6.4% (10/156 subjects) in the placebo group.

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍 투여군에서 시험 중단 사유는 동의 철회 4명, 시험대상자에 의한 중단 3명, 추적관찰 실패 1명, AE 발생 1명, 기타 3명이었으며, AE 때문에 시험을 중단한 1건은 아바트롬보팍 60mg 투여군에서 발생하였음
segments.en_txt: - Reasons for discontinuation in the avatrombopag group included withdrawal of consent (4 subjects), subject decision (3 subjects), loss to follow-up (1 subject), AE occurrence (1 subject), and other reasons (3 subjects). The 1 AE-related discontinuation occurred in the avatrombopag 60 mg group.

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍 투여군에서 시험 중단 사유는 동의 철회 4명, 시험대상자에 의한 중단 3명, 추적관찰 실패 1명, AE 발생 1명, 기타 3명이었으며, AE 때문에 시험을 중단한 1건은 아바트롬보팍 60mg 투여군에서 발생하였음
segments.en_txt: - Reasons for discontinuation in the avatrombopag group included withdrawal of consent (4 subjects), subject decision (3 subjects), loss to follow-up (1 subject), AE occurrence (1 subject), and other reasons (3 subjects). The 1 AE-related discontinuation occurred in the avatrombopag 60 mg group.

segments.ko_txt: • 투여기간
segments.en_txt: • Treatment Duration

segments.ko_txt: - 치료 노출 정도는 아바트롬보팍 투여군과 위약 투여군 사이에 비슷했고, 시험대상자의 대다수는 5일간 치료를 받았음(각각 98.2% [269/274명]; 98.7% [154/156명]).
segments.en_txt: - The treatment exposure was similar between the avatrombopag and placebo groups and most subjects received treatment for 5 days (98.2% [269/274 subjects] in the avatrombopag group; 98.7% [154/156 subjects] in the placebo group, respectively).

segments.ko_txt: - 평균(표준편차 [SD]) 노출 기간은 아바트롬보팍 투여군은 5.0(0.29)일, 위약 투여군은 5.0 (0.18)일이었음
segments.en_txt: - The mean (SD) exposure duration was 5.0 (0.29) days in the avatrombopag group and 5.0 (0.18) days in the placebo group.

segments.ko_txt: - 평균(표준편차 [SD]) 노출 기간은 아바트롬보팍 투여군은 5.0(0.29)일, 위약 투여군은 5.0 (0.18)일이었음
segments.en_txt: - The mean (SD) exposure duration was 5.0 (0.29) days in the avatrombopag group and 5.0 (0.18) days in the placebo group.

segments.ko_txt: • 인구통계학적 및 기타 특성
segments.en_txt: • Demographic and Other Characteristics

segments.ko_txt: - 연령, 성별, 민족, 인종, 체중, 체질량 지수, 인종 등 주요 인구통계학적 특성에서 다양한 투여군 간 차이는 없었음
segments.en_txt: - There were no significant differences in age, sex, ethnicity, race, weight, or body mass index between treatment groups.

segments.ko_txt: - 투여군 전반의 전체 평균(SD) 연령은 57.2(11.2)세였고 여성(34.7% [149/430명])에 비해 남성 (65.3% [281/430명])의 비율이 더 높았으며, 시험대상자의 대부분은 백인이었고(59.8% [257/430명]), 그 다음은 아시아인이었음(33.0% [142/430명])
segments.en_txt: - The overall mean (SD) age across all groups was 57.2 (11.2) years, with a higher proportion of males (65.3% [281/430 subjects]) than females (34.7% [149/430 subjects]), the majority of which were White (59.8% [257/430 subjects]), followed by Asian (33.0% [142/430 subjects]).

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍 투여군과 위약 투여군의 평균 베이스라인 혈소판 수는 각각 37.1×109/L 및 37.0×109/L로 비슷하였으며, 베이스라인 혈소판 수의 범위도 아바트롬보팍 투여군은 10.0 ~ 50.0×109/L, 위약 투여군은 11.5 ~ 49.5×109/L로 유사하였음
segments.en_txt: - The mean baseline platelet count was similar as 37.1 × 109/L in the avatrombopag group and 37.0 × 109/L in the placebo group, with a similar range (10.0-50.0 × 109/L for avatrombopag vs. 11.5–49.5 × 109/L for placebo).

segments.ko_txt: - 시험대상자 대다수는 출혈 위험이 낮은 시술을 받았고(60.8% [248/430명]), 출혈 위험이 중간인 시술은 17.2%(70/430명), 출혈 위험이 높은 시술은 22.1%(90/430명)이었으며, 시험약과 위약군간 대체로 균형을 이루었음
segments.en_txt: - The majority of subjects underwent low-risk bleeding procedures (60.8% [248/430 subjects]), while 17.2% (70/430 subjects) underwent moderate-risk procedures, and 22.1% (90/430 subjects) underwent high-risk procedures, with balanced distribution between treatment groups.

segments.ko_txt: - 시험 기간 중에 병용약물을 복용한 비율은 아바트롬보팍 투여군에서 98.5%[270/274명], 위약 투여군에서 100%[156/156명])였으며, 병용약물의 대다수는 소화성 궤양 및 위식도 역류 질환 약물 및 칼륨 보존성 제제였음
segments.en_txt: - The proportion of subjects receiving concomitant medications was 98.5% (270/274 subjects) in the avatrombopag group and 100% (156/156 subjects) in the placebo group. The most commonly used concomitant medications were for peptic ulcer and gastroesophageal reflux disease, as well as potassium-sparing agents.

segments.ko_txt: • 이상반응(TEAE, Treatment-Emergent Adverse Events)
segments.en_txt: • Treatment-Emergent Adverse Event (TEAE)

segments.ko_txt: - TEAE의 발생률은 아바트롬보팍 투여군에서 54.0%[148/274명], 위약 투여군에서 55.1% [86/156명]로 유사하였으며, 치료가 필요한 TEAE 발생률은 아바트롬보팍 투여군에서 9.5%[26/274명]), 위약 투여군에서 12.8%[20/156명]로 아바트롬보팍 투여군이 더 낮았음
segments.en_txt: - The incidence of TEAEs was similar between the avatrombopag group (54.0% [148/274 subjects]) and the placebo group (55.1% [86/156 subjects]). The incidence of TEAEs requiring treatment was lower in the avatrombopag group (9.5% [26/274 subjects]) compared to the placebo group (12.8% [20/156 subjects]).

segments.ko_txt: - TEAE의 대다수는 경증에서 중등증이었고, CTCAE 3등급 이상의 TEAE 발생률은 아바트롬보팍 투여군에서 10.9%[30/274명]), 위약 투여군에서 10.3%[16/156명])였음
segments.en_txt: - Most TEAEs were mild to moderate, and the incidence of TEAEs of CTCAE Grade ≥3 was 10.9% [30/274 subjects] in the avatrombopag group and 10.3% [16/156 subjects] in the placebo group.

segments.ko_txt: - 치료 후 발생한 중대한 이상사례(TESAE) 발생률은 아바트롬보팍 투여군에서 7.3%[20/ 274명]), 위약 투여군에서 9.0%[14/156명])였음
segments.en_txt: - The incidence of treatment-emergent serious adverse events (TESAEs) was 7.3% (20/274 subjects) in the avatrombopag group and 9.0% (14/156 subjects) in the placebo group.

segments.ko_txt: - 총 3건의 사망의 TEAE가 발생하였으며, 2건은 아바트롬보팍 40mg 투여군에서, 1건은 위약 투여군에서 발생하였으며, 시험약과 관련된 사망사례는 없었음
segments.en_txt: - A total of 3 TEAE-related deaths occurred: 2 cases in the avatrombopag 40 mg group and 1 case in the placebo group. None of the deaths were considered related to the study drug.

segments.ko_txt: - 시험약을 중단하게 만든 TEAE는 아바트롬보팍 60mg 투여군에서 2명 발생하였으며, 시험대상자 90021013에서 빈혈 및 근육통, 시험대상자 57071003에서 발열이 발생하였음
segments.en_txt: - In the avatrombopag 60 mg group, 2 cases of TEAEs led to treatment discontinuation: Subject 90021013 experienced anemia and myalgia and Subject 57071003 experienced pyrexia.

- The most commonly reported TEAEs (>3%) in both the avatrombopag and placebo groups were pyrexia (9.9% [27/274 subjects] vs. 9.0% [14/156 subjects], respectively), abdominal pain (6.6% [18/274 subjects] vs. 6.4% [10/156 subjects], respectively), nausea (6.6% [18/274 subjects] vs. 7.1% [11/156 subjects], respectively), headache (5.5% [15/274 subjects] vs. 6.4% [10/156 subjects], respectively), and upper abdominal pain (2.9% [8/274 subjects] vs. 5.1% [8/156 subjects], respectively).

segments.ko_txt: 두 투여군에서 발생한 다른 모든 TEAE는 5% 미만에서 보고되었음
segments.en_txt: All other TEAEs were reported at <5% in both treatment groups.

segments.ko_txt: - CTCAE 3 또는 4등급의 TEAE는 아바트롬보팍 투여군에서 10.2%(28/274명), 위약 투여군에서는 9.6%(15/156명)였으며, 아바트롬보팍 투여군에서 2명 이상의 시험대상자에서 보고된 사례는 호중구 수 감소(1.5%[4/274명]), 상복부 통증(0.7%[2/274명]), 아스파르테이트 아미노전이효소(AST)의 증가(0.7%[2/274명]), 간성 뇌증(0.7%[2/274명]), 저나트륨혈증(0.7%[2/274명]), 우울증(0.7%[2/274명])이었음
segments.en_txt: - CTCAE Grade 3 or 4 TEAEs occurred in 10.2% (28/274) of the avatrombopag group and 9.6% (15/156 subjects) of the placebo group. TEAEs reported in ≥2 subjects in the avatrombopag group included: neutrophil count decreased (1.5% [4/274 subjects]), upper abdominal pain (0.7% [2/274 subjects]), increased aspartate aminotransferase (AST) (0.7% [2/274 subjects]), hepatic encephalopathy (0.7% [2/274 subjects]), hyponatremia (0.7% [2/274 subjects]), and depression (0.7% [2/274 subjects]).

segments.ko_txt: - 중대한 TEAE는 아바트롬보팍 투여군에서 7.3%[20/274명], 위약 투여군에서 9.0%[14/156명] 발생하였음
segments.en_txt: Serious TEAEs occurred in 7.3% (20/274 subjects) of the avatrombopag group and 9.0% (14/156 subjects) of the placebo group.

segments.ko_txt: • 약물이상반응(ADRs)
segments.en_txt: • Adverse Drug Reactions (ADRs)

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍 투여군에서 9.5%[26/274명]), 위약 투여군에서 12.8%[20/156명]로 나타났으며, 낮은 베이스라인 혈소판 수 코호트의 위약 투여군에서 17.6%[16/91명], 아바트롬보팍 60mg 투여군에서 11.3%[18/159명]였으며, 높은 베이스라인 혈소판 수 코호트의 위약 투여군에서 6.2%[4/65명], 아바트롬보팍 40mg 투여군에서 7.0%[8/115명])였음
segments.en_txt: - The incidence of ADRs was 9.5% (26/274 subjects) in the avatrombopag group and 12.8% (20/156 subjects) in the placebo group. In the low baseline platelet count cohort, ADRs were reported in 17.6% (16/91 subjects) of the placebo group and 11.3% (18/159 subjects) of the avatrombopag 60 mg group. In the high baseline platelet count cohort, ADRs were reported in 6.2% (4/65 subjects) of the placebo group and 7.0% (8/115 subjects) of the avatrombopag 40 mg group.

- The most frequently reported ADRs in the avatrombopag group and the placebo group were headache (1.8% [5/274 subjects] vs. 4.5% [7/156 subjects], respectively), nausea (1.8% [5/274 subjects] vs. 1.9% [3/156 subjects], respectively), fatigue (1.5% [4/274 subjects] vs. 1.3% [2/156 subjects], respectively), and dizziness (1.1% [3/274 subjects] vs. 1.3% [2/156 subjects], respectively).

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍 투여군에서 보고된 사례는 뼈의 통증(아바트롬보팍- 0.7%[2/274명]; 위약- (0%[0/156명]), 설사(아바트롬보팍-0.7%[2/274명]; 위약-(1.9%[3/156명]), 발열(아바트롬보팍- 0.7%[2/274명]; 위약-(0.6%[1/156명])이었음
segments.en_txt: - ADRs reported in the avatrombopag group included: bone pain (0.7% [2/274 subjects] vs. 0% [0/156 subjects] in the placebo group), diarrhea (0.7% [2/274 subjects] vs. 1.9% [3/156 subjects]), and pyrexia (0.7% [2/274 subjects] vs. 0.6% [1/156 subjects]).

segments.ko_txt: - CTCAE 3 또는 4등급 관련 사례는 아바트롬보팍 투여군 3명(4건)에서 빈혈, 간문맥혈전증, 근육통, 두통이 발생하였음
segments.en_txt: - CTCAE Grade 3 or 4 ADRs occurred in 3 subjects (4 cases) in the avatrombopag group, including: anemia, portal vein thrombosis, myalgia, and headache.

segments.ko_txt: - 중대한 약물이상반응은 아바트롬보팍 60mg 투여군에서 0.4%[1/274명], 위약 투여군에서 1.3%[2/156명] 발생하였으며, 아바트롬보팍 투여군에서 발생한 사례는 빈혈이었음
segments.en_txt: - Serious ADRs occurred in 0.4% (1/274 subjects) of the avatrombopag 60 mg group and 1.3% (2/156 subjects) of the placebo group, which serious ADR reported in the avatrombopag group was anemia.

segments.ko_txt: - 중대한 약물이상반응은 아바트롬보팍 60mg 투여군에서 0.4%[1/274명], 위약 투여군에서 1.3%[2/156명] 발생하였으며, 아바트롬보팍 투여군에서 발생한 사례는 빈혈이었음
segments.en_txt: - Serious ADRs occurred in 0.4% (1/274 subjects) of the avatrombopag 60 mg group and 1.3% (2/156 subjects) of the placebo group, which serious ADR reported in the avatrombopag group was anemia.

segments.ko_txt: • 사망
segments.en_txt: • Deaths

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍 40mg 투여군에서 2건(다발성 장기부전, 간성 혼수), 위약 투여군에서 1건(급성 심근경색) 발생하였으며, 시험약과 관련된 사망사례는 없었음
segments.en_txt: - In the avatrombopag 40 mg group, 2 deaths were reported (multiple organ failure, hepatic coma) and 1 death in the placebo group (acute myocardial infarction). None of the deaths were considered related to the study drug.

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍 60mg 투여군에서 시험을 모두 완료하고 추가 침습성 시술을 받은 후에 시험대상자 10251003에서 TEAE가 아닌 사망이 보고되었음. 이 시험대상자에서는 비장 출혈이 발생했고, 사망은 아바트롬보팍의 마지막 용량을 투여하고 47일 후에 발생하여 아바트롬보팍과 관련이 없는 것으로 평가하였음
segments.en_txt: - In the avatrombopag 60 mg group, 1 subject (10251003) completed the study but later underwent an additional invasive procedure and was reported dead from a non-TEAE cause. This subject experienced splenic hemorrhage and died 47 days after the last avatrombopag dose. The death was assessed as unrelated to avatrombopag.

segments.ko_txt: • 특별 관심 이상사례(AESI, adverse event of special interest)
segments.en_txt: • Adverse Events of Special Interest (AESI)

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍 투여군에서 3.6%(10/274명), 위약 투여군에서 5.8%(9/156명) 발생하였으며, 아바트롬보팍 투여군에서 혈소판감소증의 재발은 발생하지 않았음.
segments.en_txt: - AESI occurred in 3.6% (10/274 subjects) of the avatrombopag group and 5.8% (9/156 subjects) in the placebo group, and no cases of recurrent thrombocytopenia were reported in the avatrombopag group.

segments.ko_txt: - 아바트롬보팍 60mg 투여군에서 출혈사건 6명(코피, 위장관 출혈, 토혈, 직장 출혈, 치조 출혈, 하지 정맥류 파열), 아바트롬보팍 40mg 투여군에서 혈전색전증(간문맥혈전증) 1명, 출혈사건 3명(위장관 출혈, 치은 출혈, 식도 정맥류 출혈) 발생하였음
segments.en_txt: - In the avatrombopag 60 mg group, 6 subject of bleeding events (epistaxis, gastrointestinal hemorrhage, hematemesis, rectal hemorrhage, alveolar hemorrhage, and rupture of lower extremity varices) were reported. In the avatrombopag 40 mg group, 1 case of thromboembolic event (portal vein thrombosis) and 3 cases of bleeding events (gastrointestinal hemorrhage, gingival bleeding, and esophageal variceal bleeding) were reported.

segments.ko_txt: - 이 중 약물과 관련된 이상사례는 아바트롬보팍 60mg 투여군에서 직장 출혈, 아바트롬보팍 40mg 투여군에서 혈전색전증(간문맥혈전증)이었음
segments.en_txt: - Among these, rectal hemorrhage in the avatrombopag 60 mg group and thromboembolism (portal vein thrombosis) in the avatrombopag 40 mg group were assessed as drug-related AEs.

segments.ko_txt: - 이 중 약물과 관련된 이상사례는 아바트롬보팍 60mg 투여군에서 직장 출혈, 아바트롬보팍 40mg 투여군에서 혈전색전증(간문맥혈전증)이었음
segments.en_txt: - Among these, rectal hemorrhage in the avatrombopag 60 mg group and thromboembolism (portal vein thrombosis) in the avatrombopag 40 mg group were assessed as drug-related AEs.

segments.ko_txt: • 임상실험실 평가
segments.en_txt: • Clinical Laboratory Assessments

segments.ko_txt: - 혈소판 수
segments.en_txt: - Platelet count

segments.ko_txt: · 아바트롬보팍 투여군의 평균 혈소판 수는 치료 4일차(방문 3)에 증가하기 시작하여, 시험10~13일차(방문 4, 시술 당일)에 최고 수치에 달한 후 시술 후 7일까지(방문 5) 감소하기 시작하여 시험 35일경에(방문 6, 추적관찰) 베이스라인 수치로 돌아왔음
segments.en_txt: · The mean platelet count in the avatrombopag group began to increase on Day 4 of treatment (Visit 3), reached its peak on Days 10-–13 (Visit 4, the procedure day), and then started to decline by Day 7 post-procedure (Visit 5), returning to baseline levels around Day 35 (Visit 6, follow-up).

segments.ko_txt: · 혈소판 수가 200×109/L 이상을 나타낸 아바트롬보팍 40mg 투여군의 시험대상자 2명의 경우, 1명은 4일차(방문 3)에, 다른 1명은 10~13일차(방문 4)에 발생하였음.
segments.en_txt: · In the avatrombopag 40 mg group, 2 subjects had platelet counts ≥200×109/L; 1 subject occurred on Day 4 (Visit 3), while the other on Days 10–13 (Visit 4).

segments.ko_txt: 혈소판 수가 200×109/L 이상인 아바트롬보팍 60mg 투여군의 시험대상자 1명은 17일차(방문 5)에 발생하였음.
segments.en_txt: In the avatrombopag 60 mg group, 1 subject had a platelet count ≥200×109/L on Day 17 (Visit 5).

segments.ko_txt: 시험대상자 모두 그 다음 방문부터 혈소판 수가 감소했고 모두 무증상이었음
segments.en_txt: All subjects’ platelet counts declined at the next visit, and they were asymptomatic.

segments.ko_txt: · 혈소판 수가 200×109/L 이상을 나타낸 아바트롬보팍 40mg 투여군의 시험대상자 2명의 경우, 1명은 4일차(방문 3)에, 다른 1명은 10~13일차(방문 4)에 발생하였음.
segments.en_txt: · In the avatrombopag 40 mg group, 2 subjects had platelet counts ≥200×109/L; 1 subject occurred on Day 4 (Visit 3), while the other on Days 10–13 (Visit 4).

segments.ko_txt: 혈소판 수가 200×109/L 이상인 아바트롬보팍 60mg 투여군의 시험대상자 1명은 17일차(방문 5)에 발생하였음.
segments.en_txt: In the avatrombopag 60 mg group, 1 subject had a platelet count ≥200×109/L on Day 17 (Visit 5).

segments.ko_txt: 시험대상자 모두 그 다음 방문부터 혈소판 수가 감소했고 모두 무증상이었음
segments.en_txt: All subjects’ platelet counts declined at the next visit, and they were asymptomatic.

segments.ko_txt: - 혈액검사, 응고인자, 임상화학검사, 소변검사, 활력징후, 심전도 등 임상 실험실 검사 결과 아바트롬보팍 투여군과 위약 투여군 간 유사한 결과를 나타내었음
segments.en_txt: - Clinical laboratory assessments, including hematology, coagulation factors, clinical chemistry, urinalysis, vital signs, and electrocardiograms, showed similar results between the avatrombopag and placebo groups.

segments.ko_txt: • 특수 집단 및 상황에서의 안전성
segments.en_txt: • Safety in Special Populations and Conditions

segments.ko_txt: - (연령) 아바트롬보팍 투여군에서 65~75세 미만인 시험대상자(67.9% [38/56명])와 75세 이상인 시험대상자(66.7% [8/12명]) 간에 TEAE의 발생률이 비슷하였음.
segments.en_txt: - (Age) The incidence of TEAEs was similar between subjects aged 65 to <75 years (67.9% [38/56 subjects]) and those aged ≥75 years (66.7% [8/12 subjects]) in the avatrombopag group.

segments.ko_txt: 연령 하위군별로 보고된 TEAE 유형의 경향성은 나타나지 않았으며 여러 연령군 간에 유사한 TEAE가 보고되었음
segments.en_txt: No trends in the types of TEAEs reported by age subgroup were identified, and similar TEAEs were observed across different age groups.

segments.ko_txt: - (성별) TEAE를 보고한 시험대상자는 전체 아바트롬보팍 투여군(63.7%[58/91명])과 위약 투여군(60.3% [35/58명])에서 여성의 비율이 더 높았고, 이에 비해 두 집단에서 남성 시험대상자의 비율은 각각 49.2% [90/183명] 및 52.0% [51/98명]였음.
segments.en_txt: - (Sex) The proportion of female subjects reporting TEAEs was higher in both the avatrombopag group (63.7% [58/91 subjects]) and the placebo group (60.3% [35/58 subjects]), whereas the proportion of male subjects in each group was 49.2% [90/183 subjects] and 52.0% [51/98 subjects], respectively.

segments.ko_txt: 성별 하위군별로 보고된 TEAE 유형의 경향성은 나타나지 않았으며 두 성별 간에 유사한 TEAE가 보고되었음
segments.en_txt: No trends in the types of TEAEs reported by sex subgroup were identified, and similar TEAEs were observed between two sexes.

segments.ko_txt: - (인종) 아바트롬보팍 투여군과 위약 투여군에서 TEAE 발생률은 백인의 경우 49.7% (79/159명) vs 46.9%(46/98명), 아시아인의 경우 59.1%(55/93명) vs 67.3%, 기타 인종의 경우 61.5%(8/13명) vs 71.4%(5/7명), 흑인의 경우 66.7%(6/9명) vs 100%(2/2명)이었음.
segments.en_txt: - (Race) The incidence of TEAEs in the avatrombopag group and placebo group was 49.7% (79/159 subjects) vs. 46.9% (46/98 subjects) among White subjects, 59.1% (55/93 subjects) vs. 67.3% among Asian subjects, 61.5% (8/13 subjects) vs. 71.4% (5/7 subjects) among subjects of other races, and 66.7% (6/9 subjects) vs. 100% (2/2 subjects) among Black subjects.

segments.ko_txt: 인종 하위군별로 보고된 TEAE 유형의 경향성은 확인되지 않았음
segments.en_txt: No trends in the types of TEAEs reported by racial subgroups were identified.

segments.ko_txt: - (지리적 위치) 아바트롬보팍 투여군과 위약 투여군에서 TEAE 발생률은 기타 지역의 경우 41.4%(12/29명) vs 43.8%(7/16명), 유럽의 경우 50.0%(45/90명) vs 48.1%(26/54명), 동아시아의 경우 58.4%(52/89명) vs 68.8%(33/48명), 북미의 경우 59.1%(39/66명) vs 52.6% (20/38명)이었음
segments.en_txt: - (Geographic location) The incidence of TEAEs in the avatrombopag group and placebo group was 41.4% (12/29 subjects) vs. 43.8% (7/16 subjects) in other regions, 50.0% (45/90 subjects) vs. 48.1% (26/54 subjects) in Europe, 58.4% (52/89 subjects) vs. 68.8% (33/48 subjects) in East Asia, and 59.1% (39/66 subjects) vs. 52.6% (20/38 subjects) in North America.

segments.ko_txt: - 베이스라인 질환 특성 하위군에 대해 투여군 간에 비슷하였고, 베이스라인 혈소판 수 하위군에 따른 TEAE 경향성은 관찰되지 않았음
segments.en_txt: - The TEAE incidence was similar between treatment groups in baseline disease characteristic subgroups, and no trends in TEAEs were observed based on baseline platelet count subgroups.
