[E5501-A001-006] A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, 3-Arm, Crossover Study to Evaluate PK, PD, Safety, and Tolerability after a Single-Dose Administration of 10, 40, 80 mg of EE5501 to Healthy Japanese, Chinese, and White Subjects Followed by Multiple Dosing of the Selected Dosage
Phase 1 | E5501-A001-006 | (U.S.) | (Objective) | To compare the PK of single-dose avatrombopag (10, 40, and 80 mg) in healthy Japanese and Chinese subjects versus healthy white subjects; | To compare the steady-state PK of multiple doses of avatrombopag 10 mg/day in healthy Japanese and Chinese subjects versus healthy white subjects; | To compare the steady-state PD of multiple doses of avatrombopag 10 mg/day in healthy Japanese and Chinese subjects versus healthy white subjects; | To evaluate the safety and tolerability of single and multiple-dose of avatrombopag in healthy Japanese, Chinese, and white subjects; | To evaluate the linearity of multi -dose avatrombopag 10, 40, and 80 mg in healthy Japanese, Chinese, and white subjects; | To evaluate the linearity of single-dose avatrombopag 10, 40, and 80 mg in healthy Japanese, Chinese, and white subject (simulation modeling); | To investigate the PK/PD relationship between avatrombopag exposure and platelet count in healthy Japanese, Chinese, and white subjects. | A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, 3-arm, crossover study | 36 healthy adult subjects | Single dose: Placebo, | 1 × 10 mg tablet, | 1 × 40 mg tablet, | 2 × 40 mg tablet, | Multiple dose: Once daily for 7 days | Placebo, 1 × 10 mg tablet | (Endpoints) PK parameter, PD parameter (platelet count), safety | (Results) | Single-dose PK parameters | PK after single doses of 10 mg and 40 mg were generally similar across ethnic groups, but the mean exposure after 80 mg was approximately 42% lower in Japanese than white subjects. | In general, the single-dose PK of avatrombopag was dose-proportional in Chinese and white subjects and slightly less dose-proportional in Japanese subjects. | Absorption was slow; maximum concentration was reached approximately 7 hours after administration and declined at a somewhat slower rate, with a final t1/2 of approximately 18 hours. | Multiple-dose PK parameters | Steady state was reached after 7 days of administration. | Moderate accumulation was observed in avatrombopag AUCs across all race groups with approximately 2-fold increased exposures at steady-state relative to Day 1. | Minimum and maximum plasma avatrombopag concentrations relative to the average concentration fluctuated similarly across race groups at about 100% during the dosing interval (24 hours). | When administered multiple times, the steady-state PK was generally similar in Japanese and white subjects, but the mean exposure (steady-state AUC [AUCss]) in Chinese was approximately 24% lower than in white subjects. Steady-state exposure is similar in Japanese and white subjects. | Multiple-dose PD parameters | In all ethnic groups, the mean increase in platelet count from baseline reached a maximum of 368×109/L on Day 11. Platelet response showed a large variability overall, but was lower than PK variability. | The washout period was sufficient for PK but not sufficient for PD, which affected the subsequent treatment period, making it impossible to reliably evaluate PD endpoints. | (Review Comment) In this study, it was not possible to evaluate the difference in PK between races. Because of the number of subjects in each group was small l(7-9), and the PK variability was large under fasted conditions.
[E5501-J081-015] A Single-Dose Study to Evaluate PK and PD of E5501 in Healthy Japanese Male Subjects
Phase 1 | E5501-J081 -015 | (Japan) | (Objective) | To evaluate the PK and PD of single oral dose administration of avatrombopag 5, 20, 40, and 60 mg under fed conditions in healthy Japanese adult male subjects; | To assess the intra- and inter-subject variability in the PK tendency of avatrombopag administered under fed conditions; | To evaluate the dose proportionality of the PK parameters of avatrombopag administered under fed conditions; | To evaluate the effect of food on PK and PD parameters; | To evaluate the safety of avatrombopag in terms of the risk of QT interval prolongation | A single-center, randomized, open-label, crossover study | 15 healthy Japanese adult male subjects | Avatrombopag 2G tablets: | Treatment period 1-3 crossover single-dose | 1: 1 × 5 mg (5 mg), fed | 2: 4 × 5 mg (20 mg), fed | 3: 8 × 5 mg (40 mg), fed | Followed by single-dose for all subjects | 4: 1×5 mg (5 mg), fasted | Followed by single-dose for all subjects | 5: 3 × 20mg (60 mg), fed | Washout period 27 days or longer | (Endpoints) PK parameter, PD parameter (platelet count), safety | (Results) | PK parameters | The PK of avatrombopag, administered as a single dose under fed conditions has slow absorption; maximum concentration is reached 6 hours (median) after administration, and the half-life is approximately 17 hours. | Exposure increases with dose at 5 mg and 20 mg, but increases more than dose proportionality at 40 mg and 60 mg. Therefore, the apparent CL/F decreases with increase in dose. | PD parameters | Emax and AUEC (0-28d) of platelet count increased with dose. | The washout period was sufficient for PK but not sufficient for PD, which affected the subsequent treatment period, making it impossible to reliably evaluate PD endpoints. | (Review Comment) Exposures were higher at all doses compared to the previous phase 1 study, but the 5 mg tablets are not a commercial formulation and the study was conducted only in Japanese subjects, making it impossible to assess whether the higher exposures were cause by racial differences.
[E5501-A001-018] A Randomized, Open-Label, 5-Period Study to evaluate PK and PD after a Single-Dose Administration of Avatrombopag in Healthy Japanese and White Subjects
Phase 1 | E5501-A001-018 | (U.S.) | (Objective) | To evaluate the similarity of PK and PD between Japanese and white subjects after administering avatrombopag 40 mg or 60 mg under fed and fasted conditions; | To evaluate the dose proportionality of avatrombopag PK after a single dose of avatrombopag 20, 40, or 60 mg administered on a fed stomach in healthy Japanese and white subjects; | To evaluate the safety and tolerability of single administration of either 20, 40, or 60mg avatrombopag doses under fed condition | To explore the effect of genetic polymorphisms of CYP2C9 on the avatrombopag PK and PK. | A randomized, open-label, 5-treatment period study | Avatrombopag 2G tablets: | 1×20 mg (20 mg), fed | 2×20 mg (40 mg), fasted/fed | 3×20 mg (60 mg), fasted/fed | Meals are high-fat diet. | (Endpoints) PK parameter, PD parameter (platelet count), safety | (Results) | PK parameters | PK of avatrombopag 40 mg and 60 mg administered under fed conditions was similar in Japanese and white subjects. | When avatrombopag 20, 40, and 60 mg were administered after meal in Japanese and white subjects, the avatrombopag Cmax and AUC parameter values ​​increased in proportion to the dose. | PD parameters | There were no clinically important differences in PD parameters between Japanese and white subjects when avatrombopag 40 mg and 60 mg were administered under fed or fasting conditions. | The effect of CYP2C9 genotype on avatrombopag PK | It was difficult to evaluate in this study due to the sample size, lack of information on delayed metabolites, and minor metabolites. | (Review Comment) In the data of the submitted approval formulation (2G 20 mg tablets) administered under fed conditions, it seemed to be no clinically important differences in avatrombopag plasma exposure or PD parameters between Japanese and white subjects.

[E5501-G000-008] 건강한 시험대상자에서 E5501과 잘 알려진 P-gp 억제제인 베라파밀 또는 시클로스포린 간의 PK 및 PD 상호작용을 평가하기 위한 라벨공개, 단일 순서, 4개 치료 기간의 임상시험 |  |  |  |  |  |  | 
1상 | E5501-G000-008 | (미국) | (목적) | 아바트롬보팍과 베라파밀 또는 시클로스포린(CsA)을 병용투여하여 아바트롬보팍 단회투여 PK 및 PD에 미치는 영향을 평가하고자 함 | 아바트롬보팍의 단회 단독 투여 또는 CsA나 베라파밀과의 단회 병용투여의 안전성 및 | 내약성을 평가하고자 함 | P-gp의 유전적 다형성이 아바트롬보팍 PK에 미치는 영향을 탐색하기 위함 | 단일기관, 라벨공개, 단일 순서, 4개 치료 기간 시험 | 건강한 성인 36명 | 치료기간 1~4 | 1, 3: 아바트롬보팍정20mg | 2: 아바트롬보팍정20mg+ 베라파밀정240mg | 4: 아바트롬보팍정20mg+ CsA400mg(100mg캡슐×4개) |  |  |  |  | (평가항목) PK 파라미터, PD 파라미터(혈소판 수), 안전성 | (결과) | 베라파밀은 아바트롬보팍의 Cmax 증가(26.2%)보다 AUC(0-inf) 증가(60.9%)에 더 큰 영향을 미쳤으며 반감기도 5.44시간만큼 유의하게 증가시켰으므로(P<0.0001), 흡수보다는 청소율에 영향을 미치는 것으로 판단됨 | 시클로스포린과 병용 투여 시에는 아바트롬보팍의 Cmax가 감소(34%)하였으나 AUC는 단독투여와 동등하였으므로 병용에 따른 상호작용이 전신 노출에 미치는 영향이 없었음 | ABCB1 유전자의 7개 DNA 서열을 분석하여 P-gp의 유전적 다양성을 평가한 결과 검사한 서열 변동성 중 아바트롬보팍 PK 파라미터와 유의한 관련이 있는 것은 없었음 | 베라파밀은 CYP3A4 유도제이기도 하기 때문에 P-gp의 억제에만 기인한 것은 아닐 수도 있음을 시사함 | 아바트롬보팍을 단독투여하거나 CsA와 병용했을 때 PD 효과는 유사하였으므로 병용투여 시 임상적으로 중요한 영향이 없었음 | 결과적으로 베라파밀이나 CsA와 같은 강한 P-gp 억제제는 아바트롬보팍의 전신 노출에 상대적으로 약한 영향을 미쳤음 | 검토의견 : 베라파밀이나 CsA와 같은 강한 P-gp 억제제는 아바트롬보팍의 전신 노출에 상대적으로 약한 영향을 미쳤으며, 임상적으로 의미있는 약물상호작용은 없었음. 아바트롬보팍과 P-gp 억제제 병용 시 용량 조절 필요성은 없는 것으로 판단됨
[E5501-A001-019] 건강한 시험대상자에 플루코나졸(CYP2C9 및 CYP3A의 중등도 억제제), 이트라코나졸(강력한 CYP3A 억제제), 또는 리팜핀(강력한 CYP3A 유도제 및 중등도 CYP2C9 유도제)과 병용투여한 아바트롬보팍의 PK DDI를 평가하기 위한 3파트, 라벨공개 시험 |  |  |  |  |  |  | 
1상 | E5501-A001-019 | (미국) | (목적) | 건강한 사람에서 플루코나졸, | 이트라코나졸, 또는 리팜핀의 병용투여가 아바트롬보팍 20 mg 단회투여의 PK 및 PD에 미치는 영향을 규명하기 위함 | 건강한 시험대상자에서 플루코나졸, 이트라코나졸, 또는 리팜핀과 병용하거나 병용하지 않은 아바트롬보팍 20 mg 단회 경구 투여의 안전성 및 내약성을 평가하기 위함 | CYP2C9 및 CYP3A5 유전자형이 플루코나졸, 이트라코나졸, 또는 리팜핀과 병용하거나 병용하지 않은 아바트롬보팍 20 mg 단회 경구 투여의 PK와 PD에 미치는 영향을 탐색하기 위함 | 건강한 시험대상자 각 파트 16명 | 단일기관, 라벨공개, DDI 시험 | 아바트롬보팍20mg(2G 정제) | 플루코나졸 정제 400mg: | 2정×200 mg | 이트라코나졸 200mg: | 2캡슐×100 mg | 리팜핀 600mg: | 2캡슐×300 mg |  |  |  |  | (평가항목) PK 파라미터, PD 파라미터(혈소판 수), 안전성 | (투여방법) | 파트 A | 치료 기간 1의 1일차에는 아바트롬보팍 20 mg을 식후 경구로 1회 투여 | 치료 기간 2에는 플루코나졸 400 mg QD를 1일차부터 16일차까지 투여하고, 그 중 7일차에 아바트롬보팍 20 mg을 식후 1회 투여 | 파트 B | 치료 기간 1의 1일차에는 아바트롬보팍 20 mg을 식후 경구로 1회 투여 | 치료 기간 2에는 이트라코나졸 200 mg BID를 1일차에, 그리고 200 mg QD를 2일차부터 16일차까지 투여하고, 그 중 7일차에 아바트롬보팍 20 mg을 식후 1회 투여 | 파트 C | 치료 기간 1의 1일차에는 아바트롬보팍 20 mg을 경구로 식후 1회 투여 | 치료 기간 2에는 리팜핀 600 mg QD를 1일차부터 16일차까지 투여. 음식에 의한 리팜핀 흡수 방해를 피하기 위해, 리팜핀은 식사 1시간 전에 투여. 그 중 7일차에, 리팜핀 600 mg는 식전에 아바트롬보팍 20 mg은 식후에 투여 | (결과) | 파트 A | 플루코나졸과 병용 시 아바트롬보팍의 평균 Cmax는 1.17배, 평균 AUC(0-inf)는 약 2.2배, 평균 t1/2은 약 20시간 증가하였으며, tmax는 유사하였음 | 플루코나졸과 병용 시 아바트롬보팍의 평균 Emax는 1.1배, ΔEmax는 1.30배, AUEC(0-28d)는 1.5배 증가하였음 | 이러한 결과는 아바트롬보팍을 플루코나졸과 병용했을 때 아바트롬보팍 PK에 중등도의 상호작용이 있음을 시사 | {'title': '', 'columns': ['', ''], 'rows': [], 'footnotes': []} | 파트 B | 이트라코나졸과 병용 시 아바트롬보팍의 평균 Cmax는 1.07배, 평균 AUC(0-inf)는 약 1.4배, 평균 t1/2은 약 8.5시간 증가하였음 | 이트라코나졸과 병용 시 아바트롬보팍의 평균 Emax는 0.98배, ΔEmax는 0.95배, AUEC(0-28d)는 1.4배 증가하였음 | {'title': '', 'columns': ['', ''], 'rows': [], 'footnotes': []} | 파트 C | 리팜핀과 병용 시 아바트롬보팍의 Cmax와 tmax 영향을 미치지 않았으나, 평균 AUC(0-inf)는 약 2배 감소하였으며, 평균 t1/2은 약 10시간 감소하였음 | 리팜핀과 병용 시 아바트롬보팍의 평균 Emax는 0.97배, ΔEmax는 0.85배, AUEC(0-28d)는 0.22배로 감소하였음 | {'title': '', 'columns': ['', ''], 'rows': [], 'footnotes': []} | 탐색적 | 아바트롬보팍 단독투여 시 CYP2C9 또는 CYP3A5 유전자형이 아바트롬보팍 PK에 미치는 영향은 관찰되지 않았음. CYP3A5의 유전자형과 상호작용의 정도 사이에 관련성은 관찰되지 않았음. CYP2C9의 유전자형이 아바트롬보팍 PK에 미치는 영향 및 상호작용의 정도는 대사 저하자(poor metabolizer)의 수가 불충분하여 평가할 수 없었음 | 검토의견 : 아바트롬보팍과 플루코나졸 병용 시 중등도, 이트라코나졸 병용 시  약한, 리팜핀 병용 시 약하거나 중등증의 상호작용이 발생하였음. 아바트롬보팍과 CYP2C9 및 CYP3A 조절제의 장기간 병용 시 용량 조절이 필요한 것으로 판단됨

[E5501-G000-008] An Open-Label, Single-Sequence, Four-Treatment-Period Study to Evaluate Pharmacokinetic and Pharmacodynamic Interactions Between E5501 and Verapamil, and E5501 and Cyclosporine, Known P-Glycoprotein Inhibitors in Healthy Subjects
Phase 1 | E5501-G000-008 | (U.S.) | (Objective) | To evaluate the effect of administering avatrombopag in combination with verapamil or cyclosporine (CsA) on the single-dose PK and PD of avatrombopag; | To evaluate the safety and tolerability of single-dose administration of avatrombopag alone or co-administration with CsA or verapamil; | To explore the effect of genetic polymorphisms of P-gp on avatrombopag PK. | A single-center, open-label, single-sequence, 4-treatment period study | 36 healthy adult subjects | Treatment period 1-4 | 1, 3: Avatrombopag 20 mg tablet | 2: Avatrombopag 20 mg tablet + verapamil 240 mg tablet | 4: Avatrombopag 20 mg tablet + CsA 400 mg (four 100 mg capsules) | (Endpoints) PK parameter, PD parameter (platelet count), safety | (Results) | Verapamil had a greater effect on the increase of AUC (0-inf) (60.9%) than the increase of Cmax (26.2%) of avatrombopag and significantly increased the half-life by 5.44 hours (P<0.0001), so it is considered to affect the clearance rather than the absorption. | When administered in combination with cyclosporine, Cmax of avatrombopag decreased (34%), but the AUC was comparable to that of administering avatrombopag alone, so the interaction due to co-administration did not affect the systemic exposure. | Evaluation of the genetic diversity of P-gp conducted by analyzing seven DNA sequences of the ABCB1 gene showed that none of the tested sequence variants were significantly related to the PK parameters of avatrombopag. | Since verapamil is also a CYP3A4 inducer, this suggests that it may not be due solely to P-gp inhibition. | When avatrombopag was administered alone or in combination with CsA, the PD effect was similar, so there was no clinically significant effect for co-administration | As a result, strong P-gp inhibitors such as verapamil or CsA had a relatively weak effect on the systemic exposure of avatrombopag. | (Review Comment) Strong P-gp inhibitors such as verapamil or CsA appeared to have a relatively weak effect on the systemic exposure of avatrombopag, and it seems to be no clinically significant drug interactions. It is considered that there is no need for dose adjustment when avatrombopag and a P-gp inhibitor are co-administered.
[E5501-A001-019] A 3-Part, Open-Label Study to Assess Pharmacokinetic Drug-Drug Interaction Between Avatrombopag When Co-Administered with Fluconazole (Moderate Inhibitor of CYP2C9 and CYP3A), Itraconazole (Strong CYP3A Inhibitor), or Rifampin (Strong CYP3A, and Moderate CYP2C9 Inducer) in Healthy Subjects.
Phase 1 | E5501-A001-019 | (U.S.) | (Objective) | To determine the effect of co-administration of fluconazole, itraconazole, or rifampin on the PK and PD of a single dose of avatrombopag 20 mg in healthy subjects; | To evaluate the safety and tolerability of a single oral dose of avatrombopag 20 mg in combination with or without fluconazole, itraconazole, or rifampicin in healthy subjects; | To explore the effect of CYP2C9 and CYP3A5 genotypes on the PK and PD of a single oral dose of avatrombopag 20 mg in combination with or without fluconazole, itraconazole, or rifampicin. | 16 healthy subjects per part | A single-center, open-label, DDI study | Avatrombopag 20 mg (2G tablet) | Fluconazole 400 mg tablet: | 2 Tablets × 200 mg | Itraconazole 200 mg: | 2 Capsule × 100 mg | Rifampin 600 mg: | 2 Capsule × 300 mg | (Endpoints) PK parameter, PD parameter (platelet count), safety | (Method of Administration) | Part A | On Day 1 of treatment period 1, avatrombopag 20 mg is administered once orally under fed conditions. | During treatment period 2, fluconazole 400 mg QD is administered from Day 1 to Day 16, and on Day 7, avatrombopag 20 mg is administered once under fed conditions. | Part B | On Day 1 of treatment period 1, avatrombopag 20 mg is administered once orally under fed conditions. | During treatment period 2, itraconazole 200 mg BID is administered on Day 1 followed by 200 mg QD from Day 2 to Day 16, and on Day 7, avatrombopag 20 mg is administered once under fed conditions. | Part C | On the Day 1 of treatment period 1, avatrombopag 20 mg is administered once orally under fed conditions. | During treatment period 2, rifampicin 600 mg QD is administered from Day 1 to Day 16. To avoid interference with the absorption of rifampicin by food, rifampicin is administered 1 hour before a meal. And on Day 7, rifampicin 600 mg was administered before a meal, and avatrombopag 20 mg was administered under fed conditions. | (Results) | Part A | When co-administered with fluconazole, the mean Cmax of avatrombopag increased by 1.17 times; the mean AUC(0-inf) increased by approximately 2.2 times; and the mean t1/2 increased by approximately 20 hours. The tmax was similar. | When co-administered with fluconazole, the mean Emax of avatrombopag increased by 1.1 times, ΔEmax by 1.30 times, and AUEC(0-28d) by 1.5 times. | These results suggest that there is a moderate interaction in the PK of avatrombopag when co-administered with fluconazole. | Part B | When co-administered with itraconazole, the mean Cmax of avatrombopag increased by 1.07 times; the mean AUC(0-inf), increased by approximately 1.4 times; and the mean t1/2 increased by approximately 8.5 hours. | When co-administered with itraconazole, the mean Emax of avatrombopag increased by 0.98 times, ΔEmax by 0.95 times, and AUEC(0-28d) by 1.4 times. | Part C | When co-administered with rifampin, the Cmax and tmax of avatrombopag were not affected, but the mean AUC(0-inf) decreased by approximately 2 times, and the mean t1/2 decreased by approximately 10 hours. | When co-administered with rifampin, the mean Emax of avatrombopag decreased by 0.97 times, ΔEmax by 0.85 times, and AUEC (0-28d) by 0.22 times. | Exploratory | No effect of CYP2C9 or CYP3A5 genotype on avatrombopag PK was observed when avatrombopag was administered alone. No correlation was observed between CYP3A5 genotype and the extent of interaction. The effect of CYP2C9 genotype on avatrombopag PK and the extent of interaction could not be evaluated due to insufficient numbers of poor metabolizers. | (Review Comment) Moderate interactions seems to be occurred when avatrombopag and fluconazole were co-administered; mild interactions seem to be occurred when co-administered with itraconazole; and mild to moderate interactions seems to be occurred when co-administered with rifampicin. Based on this DDI study, it is considered that dose adjustment appears to be is necessary when avatrombopag and CYP2C9 and CYP3A modifiers are co-administered for a long-time use.

segments.ko_txt: 분석 목표 | • 성인 ITP 환자에서 아바트롬보팍의 PK를 규명하고 건강한 사람과 비교하고자 함 | • 인구학적 정보, 실험실 검사 결과, 병용요법 등 아바트롬보팍 PK의 개인 간 변동성을 설명하는 공변량을 알아내고자 함 | • 성인 ITP 환자에서 아바트롬보팍 농도와 혈소판 수 간의 상관관계를 규명하여, 시작 용량을 선택하고 혈소판 반응에 따라 이후 용량을 조정하고자 함 | • 권장되는 용량 용법을 개발하기 위해 병용요법, 베이스라인 특성 등 노출과 혈소판 수 간의 PK/PD 상관관계에 영향을 미치는 공변량을 알아내고자 함. | 시험방법 | 건강한 사람을 대상으로 한 12건의 1상 시험과 ITP 환자를 대상으로 4건(2상 2건(501-CL-003 시험 및 501-CL-004 시험), 3상 2건(E5501-G000-302 시험 및 E5501-G000-305 시험)의 시험의 혈장 농도-시간 자료를 통합하였다. 아바트롬보팍 PK를 기술하고 아바트롬보팍 PK의 변동성을 설명할 수 있는 공변량을 평가하기 위해 집단약동학 분석을 실시하였다. ITP 환자에서 아바트롬보팍 농도와 혈소판 수의 상관관계를 기술하고 이 PK/PD 상관관계에 영향을 미칠 수 있는 공변량을 평가하기 위해 집단 PK/PD 분석도 실시하였다. | 순차적 모델 구축 방법을 이용하였다. 모델 구축은 집단약동학 모델 구축부터 시작하였다. 전통적인 접근법을 이용하여, 간단한 모델로 시작하여 구획, 지연시간, 변동성 조건, 공변량 등의 특성을 점차 추가하고 추가된 각각의 특성에 대한 통계적 유의성과 진단적 그래프의 개선 여부 및/또는 생물학적 타당성을 검정하였다. 계층적 모델의 적합도는 비선형 혼합 효과 모델(NONMEM) 소프트웨어에서 도출된 목적 함수값(OFV)의 차이를 이용하여 측정하였다. 2개의 계층적 또는 중첩(nested) 모델 사이의 OFV 차이는 n의 자유도를 가진 χ2에 근사한다. 그러므로 OFV를 사용하여 2개의 중첩 모델 사이의 차이에 관한 유의성 수준을 구하였다. | 단계적인 전진 추가(forward addition)/후진 제거(backward elimination) 방법으로 공변량 모델을 선택하였다. 전진 추가 시 각 공변량은 단변량으로 추가되었다. OFV를 가장 크게 개선시킨 공변량 모델을 선택하였다. 모델에 추가할 유의한 파라미터/공변량 조합이 더 이상 없을 때까지 단계적인 공변량 추가를 반복하였다 (이전의 유의한 공변량을 유지하면서). 전진 추가 방식으로 추가된 하나의 파라미터를 유지하려면 OFV의 최소 감소량이 적어도 6.63(p≤0.01)이거나 진단적 그래프가 개선되어야 했다. 전진 추가 단계 후에는 후진 제거를 실시하였다. 후진 제거 시 각 공변량을 모델에서 제거하였다. 적합도에 가장 적게 기여하는(즉 제거 시 OFV가 가장 적게 증가하는) 공변량을 모델에서 제거하였다. 모델에서 제거할 유의한 파라미터/공변량 조합이 더 이상 없을 때까지 단계적 공변량 제거를 반복하였다 (이전에 제거한 공변량은 계속 제거한 채로). 후진 제거 방식으로 제거한 하나의 파라미터를 유지하려면 OFV의 최소 증가량이 10.83(p≤0.001)이어야 했다. | 집단약동학 모델이 확정되면, 최종적인 개별 PK 파라미터를 PK/PD NONMEM 데이터세트에 포함하였다. 혈소판 모델링에는 수명 모델을 적용하였다. 공변량 모델은 집단약동학 공변량 분석에서 했던 것과 유사하게 단계적인 전진 추가/후진 제거 방법으로 선택하였다. 최종 PK 및 PK/PD 모델에 대해 적합도 분석, 부트스트랩 분석, VPC 평가가 수행되었다. | 최종적인 집단 PK/PD 모델을 이용하여 2차례 시뮬레이션을 수행하였다. 첫 번째 시뮬레이션(용량 적정 없이)은 아바트롬보팍의 시작 용량(20 mg QD)을 확인하기 위한 것이었다. 시뮬레이션에서는 집단약동학 및 PK/PD 분석에서 밝혀진 유의한 공변량이 혈소판 수에 어떻게 영향을 미치는지, 그리고 혈소판 수 목표 범위인 50-200×109/L를 달성하려면 아바트롬보팍 용량을 어떻게 조정해야 하는지를 평가하였다. | 두 번째 시뮬레이션은 시간 경과에 따라 50-200×109/L 기준을 달성하는 환자의 비율을 극대화하는 알고리즘에 기반한 용량 적정에 관한 것이었다. | 결과 | 건강한 사람 및 ITP 환자 577명에서 관찰한 17067개의 관찰 기록(아바트롬보팍 농도)이 집단약동학 분석에 포함되었다. ITP 환자 97명에서 관찰한 1724개의 관찰 기록(혈소판 수)이 집단 PK/PD 분석에 포함되었다. | 7명의 ITP 환자가 집단약동학 분석에서 제외되었는데, 사유는 다음과 같다. | • 2명은 농도 자료가 전혀 없었다. | • 2명은 투여 전 BLQ 농도만 있었다. | • 3명은 기존의 ITP 요법을 변경하기 전 농도 자료가 전혀 없었다. | 12명의 ITP 환자가 집단 PK/PD 분석에서 제외되었는데, 사유는 다음과 같다. | • 앞서 집단약동학 분석 부분에서 언급한 7명 | • 5명은 배경 ITP 요법을 변경하기 전의 베이스라인 이후 혈소판 수 자료가 전혀 없었다. | PK 모델의 구조는 1-구획 모델로, 저장구획(예. 장)으로의 0차 투입 및 이후 중심구획(예. 혈장 및 혈장과 빠르게 평형을 이루는 조직)에서의 1차 흡수 및 제거로 이루어졌다. | 아바트롬보팍의 최종 집단약동학 모델의 파라미터 추정치는 다음과 같다. | {'title': '', 'columns': ['', ''], 'rows': [], 'footnotes': []} | 통계적으로 유의한 상관관계를 보인 PK 파라미터와 공변량은 다음과 같으며, 최종 모델에 포함되었다. | • CL/F1: MSIND2C9(선형), MSINH2C9(선형), MSINH3A4(선형), POP(선형), WGT(멱함수) | • V/F1: WGT(선형) | • Ka: FORM(선형) | • F1: FORM(선형) | MSIND2C9 = CYP2C9 및 CYP3A4의 중등도 또는 강력한 이중 유도제(moderate or strong dual inducer) | MSINH2C9 = 중등도 또는 강력한 CYP2C9 억제제(moderate or strong inhibitor), | MSINH3A4 = 중등도 또는 강력한 CYP3A4 억제제(moderate or strong inhibitor), | POP = 건강한 또는 ITP 환자 집단(patient population(healthy or ITP)), | WGT = 베이스라인 체중(Baseline weight), | FORM = 제형(formulation). | CL/F1의 집단 추정치는 5.74 L/hr(8.87×[1-0.353] L/hr)였으며, V/F1의 집단 추정치는 235 L였다. 이러한 추정치는 평균적인 ITP 환자에 대한 결과로, 이들은 평균 체중은 74.0kg이고, 2G 정제 제형을 투여받았으며, DDI 조절제(중등도 또는 강력한 CYP3A4 또는 CYP2C9 억제제 또는 유도제)는 투여받지 않았다. 최종적인 집단약동학 모델의 모든 파라미터의 상대표준오차(RSE)는 33% 미만이었는데, 이는 합리적인 정밀도로 파라미터를 추정하였음을 의미한다. 또한, NONMEM으로 도출한 파라미터 추정치는 부트스트랩의 파라미터 추정치의 중앙값과 유사하였다. | 전형적인 건강한 자원자 및 전형적인 ITP 환자에서 모델로 예측한 AUC는 아바트롬보팍의 CL/F1의 집단 추정치를 각각 8.87L/hr및 5.74L/hr로 했을 때 각각 2255ng×hr/mL 및 3485ng×hr/mL이었다. AUC 예측값은 체중은 74.0kg이고 2G 정제 제형을 투여받았으며 DDI 조절제는 투여받지 않은 사람을 가장 일반적인 사람이라 가정하에 계산되었다. 모델로 예측한 AUC 값은 20 mg 단회투여 후의 AUC(0-inf) 또는 항정상태에서 20 mg 반복투여 후의 항정상태의 AUC였다. | 최종 집단약동학 모델에 대한 기본적인 적합도 그래프와 VPC 그래프가 생성되었고, 최종 모델(Model 25-new)은 사용하기에 적절하였다. | 집단약동학 분석이 완료된 후, 집단 PK/PD 모델을 개발하였다. 혈소판 생성에 미치는 약물 효과가 선형인 6-구획 PK/PD 수명 모델을 채택하였다. 이 모델은 CL-003 시험, CL-004 시험, CL-302 시험, CL-305 시험의 ITP 환자에서 아바트롬보팍 농도와 혈소판 수 간의 상관관계를 규명하기 위해 2개의 PK 구획과 4개의 PD 구획으로 구성되었다. 최종 PK 모델에서 도출한 개별적인 사후 파라미터 추정치를 사용하여 PK/PD 모델에 사용될 PK 노출 입력값을 생성하였다. PK/PD 모델은 1개의 전구체 생성 구획(BM1 구획)과 2개의 수송/성숙 구획(BM2 및 BM3(R2) 구획), 1개의 혈소판(혈액) 구획(혈소판 구획)으로 구성되었다. | 모델의 파라미터는 베이스라인 혈중 혈소판 수(BASE), 혈소판 생성에 대한 선형 약물 효과의 기울기(SLOPE), Kin, Kout이었다. Kdeg는 Kin을 BASE로 나누어 산출하였다. 지수함수로 BASE, SLOPE, Kin, Kout의 개인 간 변동성(IIV)를 추정하였다. BASE의 경우, 관찰된 개인의 베이스라인 혈소판 수(BPLAT)가 어떤 한 개인에서의 대표값으로 사용되었기 때문에, IIV 항에서는 베이스라인 값에 대한(설명되지 않은) 잔차 개인 내 변동성을 추정할 수 있었다. | 아바트롬보팍의 최종 집단 PK/PD 모델의 파라미터 추정치는 다음과 같다. | 공변량 분석에서는 ETA(IIV) vs. 공변량의 그래프를 생성하여 경향성이 있는지를 파악하였다. 정규 검증한 상관관계는 다음과 같았다. | • SLOPE: SPLEN(선형), BPLAT(하키스틱형), CORT(선형) | • Kin: SPLEN(선형), BPLAT(선형) | • Kout: BPLAT(선형) | Where SPLEN = 비장절제술(splenectomy; 없으면 0, 있으면 1), | BPLAT = 베이스라인 혈소판 수(Baseline platelet count), | CORT = ITP 요법으로 전신 사용한 코르티코스테로이드(없으면 0, 있으면 1). | 아자티오프린(azathioprine), 미코페놀레이트 모페틸(mycophenolate mofetil), 다나졸(danazol), CsA, 면역 글로불린(immune globulin), 지혈제 등의 다른 ITP 요법을 사용한 환자는 각각 2명 이하였다. 따라서 이들 병용약물의 잠재적 공변량 효과는 평가하지 않았다. | 검증한 상관관계 중 다음의 PD 파라미터와 공변량의 관계만 통계적으로 유의하여 이것만 최종 모델에 포함하였다. | • SLOPE: BPLAT(하키스틱형) | BPLAT = 베이스라인 혈소판 수(Baseline platelet count). 하키스틱형 상관관계의 두 부분에서의 BPLAT 컷오프는 15 × 109/L였다. | 아바트롬보팍의 SLOPE, Kin, Kout의 집단 추정치는 각각 0.0257mL/ng, 0.507×109/L/hr, 0.0359/hr였는데, 이는 베이스라인 혈소판 수가 15×109/L인 평균적인 ITP 환자에 관한 것이었다. 최종 집단 PK/PD 모델의 모든 파라미터의 RSE는 52.0% 미만이었는데, 이는 합리적인 정밀도로 파라미터를 추정하였음을 의미한다. 다만 예외적으로 SLOPE에 대한 BPLAT의 하키스틱형 상관관계의 두 번째 부분의 RSE는 191%였다. 또한, NONMEM으로 도출한 파라미터 추정치는 부트스트랩의 파라미터 추정치의 중앙값과 유사하였다.
segments.en_txt: Analysis Objectives | • To characterize the PK of avatrombopag in adult patients with ITP and compare it with healthy individuals. | • To identify covariates that explain inter-individual variability in avatrombopag PK, including demographics data, laboratory values, and concomitant therapies. | • To characterize the relationship between avatrombopag concentration and platelet count in adult with ITP, to support the selection of starting dose and adjustments based on platelet response. | • To identify covariates that affecting the PK/PD relationship between drug exposure and platelet count, including concomitant therapies and baseline characteristics, to support he development of dosing recommendations. | Analytical Procedures | Plasma concentration-time data from 12 Phase 1 studies in healthy subjects and 4 studies in patients with ITP (including 2 Phase 2 studies [Study 501-CL-003 and Study 501-CL-004] and 2 Phase 3 studies [Study E5501-G000-302 and Study E5501-G000-305]) were integrated for analysis. A population pharmacokinetic (PK) analysis was conducted to describe the avatrombopag and to evaluate the covariates that may explain the variability in avatrombopag PK. A population PK/PD analysis was also performed to describe the relationship between avatrombopag concentration and platelet count in patients with ITP and to evaluate covariates that may affect this PK/PD relationship. | A sequential model-building approach was used. The model development process began with building a population PK model. The traditional approach was employed (ie, starting with a simple model and sequentially adding model features (eg, compartments, lag times, variance terms, covariates), testing each addition f or statistical signif icance, improvement of diagnostic graphics, and/or biological plausibility. The goodness-of-fit between for hierarchical models was evaluated using the difference in the objective function value (OFV) obtained from nonlinear mixed effects model (NONMEM) software. The OFV difference between two nested models approximates a χ2 distribution with n degrees of freedom. Therefore, the OFV was used to determine the significance level of the difference between the two nested models. | A stepwise forward addition/backward elimination approach was used to select the covariate model. In the forward addition, each covariate was added to the model in a univariate manner. The covariate model that provided the greatest improvement in OFV was selected. Covariates were iteratively added until no further statistically significant parameters/covariate combinations could be included (while retaining previously significant covariates). To retain a newly added parameter with the forward addition, a minimum decrease in OFV of 6.63 (p ≤ 0.01) or an improvement in diagnostic plots was required. After the forward-addition steps, the backward elimination was performed. In the backward elimination, each covariate was removed. The covariate that contributed the least to the model fit (i.e., the one with the smallest increase in OFV upon removal) was eliminated from the model. Covariates were iteratively eliminated until no further statistically significant parameters/covariate combinations could be removed (while keeping previously eliminated covariates excluded). A minimum OFV increase of 10.83 (p ≤ 0.001) was required to retain a removed parameter with the backward elimination. | Once the population PK model was finalized, the final individual PK parameters were included in the PK/PD NONMEM dataset. A lifespan model was applied for the platelet count modeling. The covariate model was selected using a forward addition/backward elimination approach, similar to the population pharmacokinetic covariate analysis. The final PK and PK/PD models were evaluated using goodness-of-fit plots, bootstrap analysis, and VPC assessment. | Two rounds of simulations were performed using the final population PK/PD model: First simulation (without dose titration) aimed to determine the starting dose of avatrombopag (20 mg QD). 말초혈액도말검사에 의해 혈소판감소증의 다른 원인의 증거가 없는 ITP 진단이 뒷받침되었어야 함. | • 2회 측정된 혈소판 수의 평균 30×109/L 미만(2회 중 한 번이라도 35×109/L를 초과하는 수치 없음) | • 이전에 1회 이상의 ITP 요법을 받음 | • 이전 ITP 요법에 초기 반응(혈소판 수 50×109/L 초과)이 있었거나 골수이형성증후군 또는 혈소판감소증의 다른 원인을 배제하기 위해 3년 이내에 실시된 ITP와 일치하는 골수 검사 결과가 있음 | • 과다응고 상태의 이력 없이 정상 범위의 80~120% 이내의 PT/INR 및 aPTT | • CBC(혈소판 수 제외)가 기준 범위 내에 있음(예외 있음) | 연장 단계: | • 무작위배정 단계에서 6개월간의 시험 치료를 완료함 | • 치료 효과 부족으로 핵심 시험을 조기 중단함 | • 시험자가 판단했을 때, 무작위배정 단계에 시험대상자의 참여와 관련된 유의한 안전성 또는 내약성 문제는 없었음 | (주요평가) | 핵심 시험: | - 1차: • 각 방문 시 혈소판 수 • ITP 병용약물(구제 요법) 사용 • 출현 사건의 발생례와 중증도(WHO 출혈 척도 사용) | 연장 단계: | 혈소판 수, ITP 병용약물 사용, 출혈 사건의 발생률 및 중증도를 측정 | (유효성 평가결과) | - 각 방문 시 혈소판 수 | • 평균 베이스라인 혈소판 수는 엘트롬보팍 투여군(18.2 x 109/L), 아바트롬보팍 투여군(13.0 x 109/L)이었음 | • 핵심 시험 치료 5일차(방문 3)에 아바트롬보팍과 엘트롬보팍 모두에서 혈소판 수가  증가하였음 | • 베이스라인 대비 평균 혈소판 수의 변화량은 아바트롬보팍 투여군에서 12.9×109/L, 엘트롬보팍 투여군에서 8.6×109/L이었음 | • 2주차(방문 5)의 평균 혈소판 수는 아바트롬보팍 투여군에서 184.8×109/L, 엘트롬보팍 투여군에서는 91.6×109/L였음 | • 6개월의 시험 기간 동안 두 투여군 모두에서 혈소판 수가 증가했으며 아바트롬보팍 투여군의 시험대상자에서 더 높은 혈소판 수 경향이 관찰되었으며, 두 군 모두 혈소판 수 목표 범위인 50×109/L 이상 150×109/L 이하의 범위를 유지하였음 |  | - 연장 단계(n=6)의 방문별 국소 혈소판 수 중앙값(연장 단계의 첫날과 관련된 주 단위) | • 연장 단계에서 관찰된 혈소판 수 중앙값은 낮았음. 모든 시험대상자(6/6)가 시험약의 효과 부족으로 조기에 핵심 시험을 중단하였음(엘트롬보팍 투여군 5명, 아바트롬보팍 투여군 1명). | - ITP 병용약물 사용 | • 베이스라인에서 ITP 약물 사용을 보고한 시험대상자는 엘트롬보팍 투여군 1명(9.1%) 및 아바트롬보팍 투여군 2명(16.7%)으로 수가 적어 ITP 병용약물 사용의 변화를 평가할 수 없었음 | - WHO 출혈 척도를 사용하여 출혈 사건의 발생률과 중증도 | • 핵심 시험에서 엘트롬보팍 투여군(9명, 81.8%)에 비해 아바트롬보팍 투여군(6명, 46.2%)에서 출혈 사건을 보고한 시험대상자가 더 적었으며, 모두 WHO 1등급 또는 2등급이었음 | • 연장 시험에서 아바트롬보팍 투여군 5명에서 출혈사건이 보고되었으며, 모두 WHO 1등급 또는 2등급이었음 |  |  |

2 Treatment of thrombocytopenia in adult patients with chronic immune thrombocytopenia who have had an insufficient response to a previous treatment
[501-CL-003] | A Phase 2, Double-Blind, Randomized, Dose-Ranging, Placebo-Controlled, Parallel-Group Study of AKR-501 Tablets Taken Orally Once Daily for 28 Days in Patients With Chronic Idiopathic Thrombocytopenia Purpura (ITP)
Phase 2 | Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, dose-ranging, placebo-controlled, parallel-group study (United States) | Once-daily administration for 28 days | Subjects were randomized in a 3:3:3:3:1 | ratio | • Avatrombopag 2.5 mg, 5 mg, 10 mg, or 20 mg | • Placebo | A total of 64 subjects randomized | (24 males/40 females, | 59 subjects in the avatrombopag group/ 5 subjects in the placebo group) | (Study Design) | (Key Inclusion Criteria) | • Male or female subjects aged 18 years or older with a confirmed diagnosis of chronic ITP, according to ASH guidelines, for at least 3 months prior to Day 1 of the study. | • Subjects aged 60 years or older must have either a bone marrow biopsy consistent with ITP within the past 3 years or a prior positive response to ITP treatment (i.e., platelet count >100×109/L). | • ITP must be refractory or relapsed after at least 1 prior ITP therapy. | • Subjects may have been receiving stable doses of corticosteroids, cyclosporine A, mycophenolate mofetil, azathioprine, or danazol (as defined in the protocol). | • Baseline platelet count requirements: | - For subjects not receiving steroids (i.e., no steroid treatment for at least 2 weeks before Screening Visit A): Platelet count <30×109/L at Screening Visit A and within 48 hours prior to Day 1 (Screening Visit B). | - For subjects receiving steroids: Platelet count <50×109/L at Screening Visit A and within 48 hours prior to Screening Visit. | (Endpoints) | - Primary: Proportion of responders on Day 28 compared to placebo (proportion of subjects with platelet count <30×109/L at Screening Visit B (Day 1) who achieved platelet count ≥50×109/L on Day 28 and subjects with platelet count between 30×109/L and <50×109/L on Day 1 who achieved a platelet increase of ≥20×109/L from Day 1 and were receiving steroids) | - Secondary: • Change in platelet count from baseline to Day 28 (calculated using descriptive statistics). • Proportion of subjects achieving platelet count ≥50×109/L and ≥100×109/L on Day 28 and at each visit. • Proportion of subjects with a ≥2-fold increase in platelet count from baseline on Day 28 and at each visit. • Responder rate at each visit. • PK/PD relationship of avatrombopag. | (Primary Efficacy Results) | Overall responder rate (Last Observation Carried Forward [LOCF] method) was 0% in the placebo group and 49.2% across all avatrombopag group. | The responder rate in the avatrombopag 20 mg group significantly increased on Day 28 compared to placebo (80.0% vs. 0%; p = 0.0036). | Treatment difference between the avatrombopag 20 mg group and 2.5 mg group was statistically significant (P = 0.0007). | (Secondary Efficacy Results) | - Change in platelet count from baseline to Day 28 | • In the 5 mg, 10 mg, and 20 mg avatrombopag groups, platelet count increases were observed from Day 7, with the median platelet count peaking on Day 14 in the 10 mg (3.9-fold increase) and 20 mg (12.2-fold increase) groups. | • Platelet counts subsequently declined but remained elevated compared to baseline on Day 28 in the 10 mg (2.2-fold increase) and 20 mg (4.6-fold increase) groups. | • No platelet count increase was observed in the placebo or avatrombopag 2.5 mg group on Day 28. | - Proportion of subjects achieving platelet count ≥50×109/L on Day 28 | • Avatrombopag 20 mg group (80.0%) was significantly higher than placebo group on Day 28. The proportion of subjects achieving platelet count ≥50×109/L was higher in the 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg avatrombopag groups compared to placebo, but not statistically significant. | - Proportion of subjects achieving platelet count ≥50×109/L at each visit | • At Day 7, the proportion was 6.7%, 66.7%, 64.3%, and 93.3% in the 2.5 mg, 5 mg, 10 mg, and 20 mg treatment group, respectively, compared to the placebo. The 20 mg group peaked on Day 7, while the 2.5 mg and 10 mg groups peaked on Day 14. The 5 mg group remained stable but showed a slight decline by Day 28. | - Proportion of subjects achieving platelet count ≥100×109/L on Day 28 | • The proportion of subjects achieving platelet count ≥100×109/L was higher in the avatrombopag 2.5 mg, 5 mg, 10 mg, and 20 mg groups compared to placebo on Day 28, but not statistically significant. | - Proportion of subjects achieving platelet count ≥100×109/L at each visit | • At Day 7, the proportion was 6.7%, 20.0%, 28.6%, and 80.0% in the 2.5 mg, 5 mg, 10 mg, and 20 mg treatment group, respectively, compared to the placebo. | - Proportion of subjects with a ≥2-fold increase in platelet count from baseline on Day 28 | • Only the 20 mg group significantly increased compared to placebo (P = 0.0139): placebo (20%), 2.5 mg (13.3%), 5 mg (53.3%), 10 mg (57.1%), 20 mg (86.7%). | - Proportion of subjects with a ≥2-fold increase in platelet count at each visit | • At Day 7, the proportion of subjects with a ≥2-fold increase in platelet count was: placebo (20%), 2.5 mg (33.3%), 5 mg (60.0%), 10 mg (78.6%), 20 mg (93.3%). | - Responder rate at each visit | • No subjects in the placebo group showed a platelet response. At Day 7, the highest responder rate was in the avatrombopag 20 mg group (93.3%), which remained consistently higher than all other dose groups (2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg) at all subsequent visits.
501-CL-004 | A Phase 2, Parallel-Group, Rollover Study of AKR-501 in Patients With Chronic Idiopathic Thrombocytopenia Purpura (ITP) Who Completed28 Days’ of Study Treatment in Protocol AKR-501-CL-003
Phase 2 | Global, randomized, double-blind, | placebo-controlled, parallel-group, dose titration study (United States) | Once-daily administration for 6 months following completion of CL-003: | Responders (n = 25) | • Continued the same double-blind treatment and daily dose as in CL-003 (placebo or avatrombopag 2.5 mg, 5.0 mg, 10.0 mg, or 20 mg). | Non-responders (n = 28) | • Open-label treatment with an initial dose of avatrombopag 10 mg. | (Study Design) | (Key Inclusion Criteria) | • Completion of the 28-day treatment in Study CL-003. | • No significant safety or tolerability concerns related to CL-003 participation by the investigator’s discretion. | • Subjects must receive approval from the medical monitor after review of their data from Study CL-003 to enroll in this study. | (Endpoints) | - Primary: Safety and tolerability of avatrombopag | - Secondary: Efficacy of avatrombopag | • Actual platelet count and change from baseline (i.e., prior to Day 1 of Study CL-003) at each visit. | • Platelet count, change, and rate of change from Day 1 of Study CL-004 to each subsequent visit. | • Number and proportion of subjects achieving a response level* at each analysis visit. | * For subjects with baseline platelet count <30×109/L: achieving platelet count ≥50×109/L. For subjects receiving steroids with baseline platelet count between 30×109/L and <50×109/L: achieving an increase of >20×109/L. | • In Study CL-004, Proportion of subjects achieving sustained response, defined as having at least 3 platelet count assessments during the last 14 weeks of the 24-week treatment period, and at least 75% of platelet counts during this period meeting the response level criteria. Subjects could not receive rescue medication during the 24-week treatment period. | • Proportion of subjects achieving a transient response, defined as subjects in Study CL-004 who did not achieve a durable response over the 24-week treatment period but reached response-level platelet counts in at least 2 consecutive analysis windows. Subjects could not receive rescue medication before or during this period. However, subjects who received rescue medication could still be considered transient responders for the period before initiating rescue medication. | • Overall response rate, including both transient and durable responses. | • Proportion of subjects maintaining response level. Subjects in this category should be (1) responders on Day 28 of Study CL-003, (2) achieved sustained response in Study CL-004, and (3) with no upward titration during Study CL-004. | • Proportion of subjects achieving platelet count ≥100×109/L. | • Proportion of subjects maintaining platelet count ≥100×109/L. Subjects in this category should be (1) responders on Day 28 of Study CL-003, (2) with no upward titration during Study CL-004, (3) at least 75% of platelet counts from 7 analysis windows during the last 14 weeks of the 24-week treatment period were ≥100×109/L, and (4) with no use of rescue medication during the treatment period. | • Proportion of subjects who permanently discontinued concomitant steroid use. | • Proportion of subjects who reduced concomitant ITP-directed steroid use by at least 50% compared to their last steroid dose before Study CL-004. | • Number and percentage of subjects using concomitant ITP- directed medications and rescue medications. | (Primary Efficacy Results) Safety and tolerability of avatrombopag | (Secondary Efficacy Results) | - Platelet response data | • During the 24-week avatrombopag treatment period, the median platelet count increased from 22×109/L to 112.5×109/L. | • In the overall responder group, the median platelet count increased from 24×109/L to 154×109/L, while in the overall non-responder group, it increased from 18×109/L to 66×109/L. | • Throughout the 6-month treatment period, all median platelet counts remained within the range of 50–150×109/L. | • During the 4-week follow-up period after the end of treatment (EOT), platelet counts decreased in both the overall responder and non-responder groups starting from Week 24. | - Proportion of subjects achieving platelet count ≥100×109/L | • At all assessment time points, a higher proportion of subjects in the responder group achieved platelet counts ≥100×109/L compared to the non-responder group. | • At Week 24, 71.4% (15/21) of responders and 35.3% (6/17) of prior non-responders achieved platelet counts ≥100×109/L. | • Among the responders, most subjects who achieved platelet counts ≥100×109/L received avatrombopag 10 mg or 20 mg. | • Among the prior non-responders, most subjects who achieved platelet counts ≥100×109/L had previously received placebo, avatrombopag 2.5 mg, or 5 mg in Study CL-003. This suggests that some subjects required higher doses of avatrombopag to achieve a platelet response. | - Proportion of subjects maintaining platelet count ≥100×109/L | • The platelet counts of 8 prior responders (32%) maintained ≥100×109/L in Study CL-004 (non-responders were not included based on definition). | • No clear dose-response relationship was observed at doses ≥5 mg of avatrombopag. | - Proportion of subjects achieving or maintaining response-level platelet counts | • Among the 25 responders from Study CL-003, 14 subjects (56.0%) maintained a platelet response. | • Among these 14 subjects, more than half (n=8, 57.1%) maintained platelet counts ≥100×109/L. | • At Week 24, 71.4% (n= 15/21) of responders and 35.3% (n= 6/17) of prior non-responders achieved platelet counts ≥100×109/L. | - Proportion of subjects achieving a sustained response over the 6-month treatment period | • 52.8% of overall population, 72.0% of responder group, 35.7% of non-responder group | - Proportion of subjects achieving an overall response | • 75.5% of overall population, 88.0% of responder group, 64.3% of non-responder group | • Among prior non-responders from Study CL-003 who received placebo, avatrombopag 2.5 mg, or 5 mg in that study but were treated with open-label avatrombopag 10 mg in CL-004, the overall platelet response rates were 80%, 70%, 80%, respectively. | - Upward titration and response analysis | • Upward titration was required when platelet counts fell below the response level in 2 consecutive assessments. | • No dose upward titration was required in CL-004 for any prior responders from CL-003, except for those who had been assigned to avatrombopag 2.5 mg. | • 20% (5/25) of responders and 75% (21/28) of non-responders required upward titration; among 13 subjects (50.0% of those who required upward titration) underwent upward titration, of whom 10/13 (76.9%) achieved an overall response and 7/13 (53.8%) achieved a sustained response. Most prior non-responders from Study CL-003 who required dose escalation responded to higher doses of avatrombopag. | - Steroid use | • Approximately one-third (33.3%) of subjects receiving concomitant steroids permanently discontinued steroid use during Study CL-004, regardless of responder status. | • Among the 4 subjects in the responder group who permanently discontinued steroid use, 3 (75%) received avatrombopag 10 mg or 20 mg. | • More than half (54.2%) of subjects receiving concomitant steroids reduced steroid use by at least 50%, regardless of responder status.
E5501-G000-302 (Study 302) | A Phase 3, Multicenter, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Parallel-Group Trial With an Open-label Extension Phase to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Oral E5501 Plus Standard Care for the Treatment of Thrombocytopenia in Adults With Chronic Immune Thrombocytopenia (Idiopathic Thrombocytopenic Purpura)
Phase 3 | Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group, | Phase 3 study with an open-label extension phase | (11 countries, 27 sites) | Core study: | • Avatrombopag group: Once-daily oral administration of avatrombopag (5, 10, 20, 30, or 40 mg) with food. | • Placebo group: | Once-daily oral administration of placebo matching avatrombopag doses (5, 10, 20, 30, or 40 mg) with food. | Extension phase: | • Following dose adjustment per protocol-defined titration guidelines, subjects received open-label avatrombopag starting at 20 mg once daily with food (up to a maximum of 2 years). | Randomized subjects: 49 subjects | Avatrombopag group/Placebo group: 32/17 subjects | (Study Design) | - Baseline/Randomization (Day 1) | - Titration (6 weeks; subjects returned on Days 5, 8, 14, 21, and 28) | - concomitant ITP medication reduction period (12 weeks; subjects returned every 2 weeks) | - Maintenance (8 weeks, including the end of treatment [EOT] visit; subjects returned weekly, and primary endpoint evaluations were conducted during this period) | - 경정맥 혈전증 37세 백인 여성 | - 맹장 절제술, 제왕절개, 여성 불임술, 경부 원추 절제술의 병력이 있었다. | - 아바트롬보팍 요법을 중단한 지 2일 후에 2등급 경정맥 혈전증을 보고했다. 사고 당시 혈소판 수는 130×109/L였다.
심정맥 혈전증 64세 여성 | - 시험 진입 시점에 자궁절제술 및 단클론성 감마병증 병력이 진행중이었으며, 시험 중에 만성골수단핵구성백혈병(CMML) 진단을 받았다. | - 20mg의 아바트롬보팍을 투여 받고 있던 중 오른쪽 하지에 2등급 심정맥 혈전증이 발생했다. 이 사건 발생 시 혈소판 수는 271×109/L였다.
무증상폐색전증 45세 여성 | - 페니실린 알레르기, 간혈관종, 고혈압의 병력이 있었다. | - 10mg의 아바트롬보팍을 투여받고 있다가 2등급의 폐색전증을 보고했다. | - 이는 흉막삼출 및 다발성 장막염을 조사하는 동안 CT 스캔 및 혈관조영술에서 우연히 발견된 소견이었다.  폐색전증은 흉막삼출의 반대편에서 발견되었으며 무증상이었다. | - 사고 당시 혈소판 수는 316×109/L였다
segments.en_txt:
Jugular vein thrombosis 37-year-old White female | - The subject had a medical history of appendectomy, cesarean section, female sterilization, and cervical conization. | - A Grade 2 jugular vein thrombosis was reported 2 days after discontinuing avatrombopag therapy. At the time of the event, the platelet count was 130×109/L.
Deep venous thrombosis 64-year-old female | - The subject had a medical history of hysterectomy and ongoing monoclonal gammopathy at study entry and was later diagnosed with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia (CMML) during the study. | - The subject experienced Grade 2 deep venous thrombosis in the right lower extremity after receiving avatrombopag 20 mg. At the time of the event, the platelet count was 271×109/L.
Asymptomatic pulmonary embolism 45-year-old female | - The subject had a medical history of penicillin allergy, hepatic hemangioma, and hypertension. | - The subject reported a Grade 2 pulmonary embolism while receiving avatrombopag 10 mg. | - This was an incidental finding on a CT scan and angiography performed during an investigation for pleural effusion and polyserositis. The pulmonary embolism was found on the opposite side of the pleural effusion and was asymptomatic. | - At the time of the event, the platelet count was 316×109/L.

segments.ko_txt: 골수 섬유증 61세 백인 여성 | - 시험 진입 시점에 고혈압, 단클론성 감마글로불린혈증 및 만성 갑상선염이 진행 중이었으며, 시험 완료 8일 후에 골수 생검을 받았으며 콜라겐이 없는 레티쿨린 섬유증(MF-1)(골수 섬유증으로 보고됨)의 증가를 보고하였다. | - 약 202일 동안 시험약을 투여받았으며, 아바트롬보팍 투여 전에는 비교할 수 있는 베이스라인 생검이 없었으므로 베이스라인에서 레티쿨린 축적의 존재를 배제할 수 없다.
segments.en_txt: Myelofibrosis 61-year-old White female | - The subject had a history of hypertension, monoclonal gammopathy, and chronic thyroiditis at study entry and underwent a bone marrow biopsy 8 days after study completion, which reported an increase in collagen-free reticulin fibrosis (MF-1) (diagnosed as myelofibrosis). | - The subject received avatrombopag for approximately 202 days, and as there was no comparable baseline biopsy before avatrombopag treatment, the presence of pre-existing reticulin accumulation at baseline could not be ruled out.
